name: Tuesday Night Social Road Ride (Taco Tuesdays)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:30 pm, through the summer

start_location.name: Bartlett High School student parking lot

description: A no-drop Tuesday night road ride started to give Anchorage roadies something they can count on every week. Meets at the Bartlett High lot, rides the Glenn Highway path out toward Eagle River, and ends at tacos or pizza. Rain or shine. Road or gravel bikes recommended.

name: Le Tour de Ham
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm
description: Birmingham's slow Tuesday ride. Ten to twelve miles, no rider left behind, any bike. The same crew runs a Saturday morning stroll from Uptown. Start point and details were last confirmed in a 2018 write-up; check the Facebook page before you go.

name: Trample
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm
description: Weekly ride from Birmingham's nonprofit community bike shop. One big group across downtown, about ten mostly flat miles, beginner to expert and all ages. The shop's other events (alley cats, tall bike jousts, Cranksgiving) grow out of this crowd.

name: Pro Cycle Thursday Night Social Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm (spring and summer)
description: The easier of the shop's two weeknight rides on the Eastern Shore of Mobile Bay. Twenty miles at 17 to 18 mph, no-drop. Tuesday is the hammerfest; Saturday morning is a 28-mile year-round ride.

name: Sunset Rides
schedule: Every Wednesday, April–September; 5:30 pm in April, 6:00 pm from May, shifting with daylight

start_location.name: Sunset Bicycles
start_location.address: 8402 Whitesburg Dr SE Suite F, Huntsville, AL 35802

description: A chill Wednesday cruise through Huntsville neighborhoods and greenways that ends with the sunset. Two routes, 18 or 25 miles, around 14 mph. Helmets, lights and water required. Any bike with smooth tires.

name: Tour de Coler
schedule: Every Tuesday evening

start_location.name: The Grove parking lot, Coler Mountain Bike Preserve
start_location.address: Coler Mountain Bike Preserve, Bentonville, AR 72712

description: A free weekly mountain bike group ride at Coler, run by the foundation that manages the preserve. All skill levels, meeting at The Grove parking lot. Check the Coler events page for the time.

name: Sunday Service
schedule: Every Sunday, usually 10:30 am
founded_note: Bike Club describes Sunday Service as its original Fayetteville group ride, started to reunite the NWA road scene
description: The long, steady Sunday road ride out of Fayetteville. Three to four hours at 18 mph or better through the Ozark hills. Not a beginner ride. Bike Club also runs Tuesday Night Worlds, a race-pace ride, from the same spot.

name: Arkansas Bicycle Club Sunday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 1:00 pm

start_location.name: Two Rivers Park Bridge
start_location.address: 99 River Mountain Rd, Little Rock, AR 72223

pace: beginner to intermediate, faster and slower riders
description: The club's standing Sunday afternoon ride from the Two Rivers bridge. Eighteen to 35 miles with an optional Fort Roots climb. The club calls it a good introduction to group riding because faster and slower riders both show up. Tuesday and Thursday morning rides leave from the Big Dam Bridge.

name: Heels on Wheels Monday Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 5:30 pm

start_location.name: William J. Clinton Presidential Library
start_location.address: 1200 President Clinton Ave, Little Rock, AR 72201

description: A women's cycling group with a beginner-pace Monday evening ride from the Clinton Library along the river trail. Twelve to 15 miles. The group also rides Thursday evenings from the Big Dam Bridge and Saturday mornings from the submarine in North Little Rock.

name: Major Taylor Cycling Club Little Rock Evening Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Big Dam Bridge, Little Rock side
start_location.address: 7600 Rebsamen Park Rd, Little Rock, AR 72207

host.name: Major Taylor Cycling Club of Little Rock

description: Twice-weekly evening road ride from the Little Rock side of the Big Dam Bridge, run by the local Major Taylor club. Intermediate to advanced pace. Major Taylor clubs grew out of Black cycling communities and are open to all.

name: Chandler North Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, meet 5:45 am, roll 6:00 am
pace: A 22+ mph, B 18+ mph, C 15+ mph
description: A Saturday shop ride with three pace groups. The C group holds a steady 15 mph and keeps the group together. Faster groups go longer. RSVP on the shop's Meetup, which has over 5,000 members.

name: VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 8:00 am
cost: free for a first ride; membership after
description: A midweek road ride in the Verde Valley from a Cottonwood coffee shop, with coffee back at the shop afterward. The same club also rides Tuesdays from Old Town Cottonwood and Thursdays from Sedona. Non-members can try one ride before joining.

name: Mormon Lake Lodge Out-and-Back
schedule: Every Thursday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: Lake Mary Rd & Forest Service Road 132 (Mormon Lake Lodge)
start_location.address: Lake Mary Rd, Mormon Lake, AZ 86038

cost: free for a first ride; membership after
description: A Thursday road ride on Lake Mary Road in the pines about 25 miles southeast of Flagstaff. Out and back from the lodge. Posted on the Verde Valley club's Meetup, where riders from Flagstaff and the valley meet up.

name: Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, meet 5:45 am, roll 6:00 am
description: A short, medium-paced Sunday ride from the Gilbert shop. Regular bikes and e-bikes both welcome. The shop says plainly: 'we won't leave you behind.' Good first group ride.

name: Monday Night Meander
schedule: Every Monday, 7:00 pm

start_location.name: West Valley Casual Bike Rides meet spot

founded_note: Group describes itself as 'bicycle rides for all skill levels since 2012' on its Meetup page
description: A casual 15–20 mile Monday evening ride in the West Valley. The group's motto is 'nobody gets left behind.' Any bike and any fitness level. The same group also runs a Wednesday sunrise ride and a Thursday night ride.

name: Phoenix Downtempo Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 8:00 pm
description: A slow Monday night roll through downtown Phoenix that ends at a bar or restaurant. Any bike works. The route stays flat except for short ramps over the freeway. It is about an hour of riding, then hanging out.

name: Taco Tuesday Ride at South Mountain
schedule: Every Tuesday, 7:15 pm

start_location.name: Kyrene de las Lomas Elementary School
start_location.address: 11820 S Warner Elliot Loop, Phoenix, AZ 85044

description: A Tuesday night mountain bike ride on South Mountain trails. Lights are required. Organizers ask for at least five prior mountain bike rides before you join. Distance depends on weather, usually 7–12 miles. Tacos after.

name: Bike Prescott Thursday Mountain Bike Series
schedule: Every Thursday morning (8:00 am in September; trailhead changes weekly)
cost: free to try; club membership for insurance coverage
description: A weekly Thursday trail ride from the Prescott cycling club. The trailhead rotates around the Prescott National Forest; a recent one left Aspen Creek Trailhead in Groom Creek. Helmets required. The club also runs no-drop road and gravel rides most days of the week, all posted on Meetup.

name: Soul Ride Sunday Shop Ride
schedule: Every Sunday (time posted on the shop's social pages)

start_location.name: Soul Ride Bike Shop & Taproom (parking lot behind the shop)

pace: A team fast, 25–40 mi; B team moderate no-drop, 12–20 mi
description: A Sunday mountain bike ride from a downtown Prescott shop with a taproom. Two groups: a fast A team and a moderate, no-drop B team. Riders pedal 3–6 miles to the trailheads and back, then hang out on the patio.

name: Absolute Bikes Sedona Shop Rides
schedule: Thursdays and Sundays in spring and fall (Sunday meets about 3:45 pm, rolls 4:00 pm)
description: Employee-led trail rides straight from the Village of Oak Creek shop. Length and difficulty change week to week. Runs in the cooler months only. Bring water, snacks and a repair kit.

name: Sedona Wednesday Evening Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday evening

host.name: Verde Valley Cyclists Coalition / Sedona MTB Facebook group

founded_note: The 'Official Sedona Wednesday Mountain Bike Ride' Facebook group was created July 2022
description: A weekly intermediate trail ride in West Sedona, coordinated through a Facebook group of about 600 locals and visitors. No-drop. Meeting spot and time are posted each week in the group.

name: Regroup Saturday Coffee Ride
schedule: Every Saturday morning (6:00 am in September; start shifts with the season)
description: A Saturday road ride out of a coffee shop and bike shop in Tempe. Riders split into groups by ability and the ride is billed as no-drop. It ends back at the cafe with coffee and pastries. Routes change weekly; a recent one went to South Mountain for 46 miles.

name: BICAS WTF Ride
schedule: Last Monday of the month, evening
description: A monthly night ride for women, trans and femme riders, run out of the BICAS community bike shop. It grows out of the weekly WTF workshop, which runs Mondays 3–7 pm. The June edition is a Pride ride. All WTF-identifying folks welcome.

name: FUGA Southside Ride (Bicicleteada del Sur)
schedule: Last Friday of the month, meet 6:00 pm, ride 6:30–8:30 pm
description: A monthly community ride on Tucson's south side, organized by a Latino-led group that works on street safety and access. Families and all ages ride together at an easy pace. FUGA also runs a second-Sunday westside ride from November to April.

name: The Shootout
schedule: Every Saturday morning; start varies 6:00–7:30 am by season

start_location.name: University Blvd & Euclid Ave
start_location.address: University Blvd & N Euclid Ave, Tucson, AZ 85719

pace: A 22–28+ mph; Scootout 19–23 mph; Old-Old Man 16–20 mph

host.name: The Shootout (documented by Fair Wheel Bikes)

description: Tucson's famous fast Saturday road ride. Three groups leave a few minutes apart on the same route south of town. It is self-supported and riders separate by pace. Not a beginner ride. The 16–20 mph group is the friendliest option.

name: Tuesday Night Ride (TNR)
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 8:30 pm, roll 8:45 pm

start_location.name: Flagpole in front of Old Main, University of Arizona

founded_note: Described as a community tradition of 15+ years in 2021 by Cyclovia Tucson
description: Tucson's big weekly party ride. Dozens of riders meet at the Old Main flagpole and roll through streets, alleys, parks and parking lots for about two hours. Bring lights and a helmet. Adults and experienced riders are the norm.

name: Women's Shootout Tucson
schedule: Every Saturday, meet 6:00 am, roll 6:15 am (shifts with season)

start_location.name: Mercado San Agustín
start_location.address: 100 S Avenida del Convento, Tucson, AZ 85745

description: A women's Saturday road ride from the Mercado on Tucson's west side. Pick 30, 40 or 50 miles. Organizers ask for some road riding experience. Check the Instagram for seasonal start times.

name: Bike Bakersfield Full Moon Ride
schedule: Monthly on or near the full moon; details on Instagram and Facebook
description: The Central Valley's bike coalition and community bike kitchen runs a monthly full moon night ride, posted each month on its Instagram. Casual pace, any bike. The organization also runs a shop at 1708 Chester Ave and bike rodeos.

name: Swami's Monthly Sunday Social Ride
schedule: One Sunday a month (time posted on the club calendar); weekly World Famous Saturday Ride from Encinitas

start_location.name: Bird Rock Coffee Roasters, Bressi Ranch

founded_note: Club says it has run for more than 50 years
description: North County's big club opens one ride a month to anyone comfortable with 30 miles: a two-by-two, conversational, no-drop loop from a coffee shop in Bressi Ranch. Its weekly Saturday A/B ride out of Encinitas is the fast one, and it is not no-drop.

name: Easy Does It Sunday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 1:00 pm

start_location.name: Hooker Oak Park, center of the parking lot

description: An easy no-drop ride from a Chico bike shop. About 12 miles at 11 mph on a mix of Bidwell Park, back roads and bike paths. Built for new riders and people getting back on the bike. Helmets required. The shop also runs a no-drop road ride Fridays at 9 am from One Mile.

name: Tuesday Bakery Easy Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 9:00 am (8:00 am late May through mid-September)
cost: free for one guest ride, then club membership
description: Also called the Tuesday Dixon Donut Ride. A casual 26-mile ride through farm country to Dixon with a stop at Solano Bakery. Pace is 12 to 14 mph. Winds over 20 mph cancel it. Helmets required; guests can ride once before joining the club.

name: Leucadia Cyclery Sunday Social Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 8:00 am (Wednesday Warriors 6:00 pm from Cardiff State Beach; women's ride Saturday 9:00 am)
description: A beginner-friendly Sunday morning spin along the coast from the shop, 15 to 20 miles at 10 to 12 mph. Just show up or call the store. The shop also lists a Wednesday evening intermediate ride and a Saturday women's group with rotating starts.

name: Fresno Cycling Club Monthly Birthday Rides
schedule: One Saturday a month, meet 7:45 am, roll 8:00 am (September 2026 edition on the 19th)

start_location.name: Steven's parking lot
start_location.address: Willow Ave & Nees Ave, Fresno, CA 93720

pace: B, C and C/D groups with leaders
founded_note: Founded 1962, per fresnocycling.com
description: The Fresno Cycling Club, going since 1962, runs a monthly birthday ride with B, C and C/D groups heading into the foothills toward Millerton, Humphreys or Tollhouse. Each group has a leader. The club rates rides by pace and terrain so you can pick the right one.

name: HB Velo Sunday Morning Shop Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, roll-out 8:05 am sharp (Wed/Fri coffee ride 8:30 am, ~25 mi at 15 mph)
description: Fast Sunday shop ride out of HB Velo, 25 to 70 miles at about 18 mph. The Wednesday and Friday coffee rides are the easier option at 15 mph and about 25 miles. Ride updates are posted on the shop's Facebook page.

name: BCI Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am (Tuesday 9:15 am and Sunday 9:00 am rides also)
pace: friendly, regroup at a coffee stop
cost: free for guests (sign a free annual ticket); $25/year membership
description: Calls itself the friendliest bike club in Orange County. Every Saturday there are short, medium and long route slips from Deerfield Park with a regroup at a coffee stop. Guests ride free after signing a waiver. Under 18 must ride with a parent.

name: OCW Tuesday/Thursday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 9:00 am (weekend rides too)
founded_note: Founded 1968, per the club's home page
description: One of the original Orange County clubs runs weekday training rides from Bill Barber Park. You don't need to be a member to ride and they say all abilities are welcome. Routes are 35 to 40 miles and posted in their Ride with GPS library.

name: Bikes and Coffee (Bike Long Beach)
schedule: Last Sunday of the month, meet 9:30 am, roll 10:00 am

start_location.name: Varies (usually Gaucho Beach, SteelCraft, or the end of the beach path at Ocean & Bayshore)

description: A monthly slow ride on bike paths and quiet streets to a different coffee spot each time. Meant for people new to cycling; any bike works. Led by volunteers from the local advocacy group. No one gets left behind.

name: C U Next Tuesday (Queercicles)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 8:00 am
pace: moderate (one chili on the local ride list)
description: A Tuesday morning ride led by Laila of Queercicles, a queer cycling crew in Long Beach. Listed on the community-maintained Long Beach Bike Rides calendar with a moderate pace rating. Check Instagram for the week's route.

name: Lightning Velo Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am (also Sunday 8:00 am)

start_location.name: Marina Dr parking lot (temporary start during Studebaker Rd construction)
start_location.address: 6460 E Marina Dr, Long Beach, CA 90803

pace: A 23+ mph, B 19–22 (no drop), C 15–18 (no drop), D 10–15 developmental
description: Road club with four groups rolling every Saturday and Sunday morning. B and C groups are no-drop double pacelines; the D group is for newer road riders and covers skills and rules of the road. Rides end at a coffee shop in Seal Beach.

name: Long Beach Bicycling Meetup Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:00 pm

start_location.name: Long Beach Windsurf Center
start_location.address: 3850 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

description: Casual evening ride toward Seal Beach or the Queen Mary and back, 60 to 90 minutes. Beach cruisers to mountain bikes all show up. Many riders stop for a drink afterward. About 1,400 members on Meetup.

name: Different Spokes Sunday Ride
schedule: Sundays; route and start rotate and are posted on the club calendar
founded_note: Founded 1983 from a newspaper ad to promote cycling among the gay and lesbian community, per the club and LA Times
description: Southern California's LGBTQ+ cycling club, riding since 1983. Sunday rides across the LA area from easy to hard, with a monthly easier ride. Everyone is welcome; helmets required. Check the club calendar for this week's start.

name: La Grange Women's Ride
schedule: 3rd Saturday of the month, 8:00 am, rotating Westside start
description: Monthly ride for female-identifying cyclists, members and guests. Social pace with regroups; the club says no one gets left behind. Riders should be comfortable clipped in and have some climbing experience. Start location rotates and is posted on Strava and Instagram.

name: Nichols Canyon Ride (Velo Club La Grange)
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am

start_location.name: Raymond Fouquet Square
start_location.address: Westwood Blvd & La Grange Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90024

description: The Saturday club ride of one of LA's oldest and largest cycling clubs. Hard pace with racers in the group, so the club suggests newer riders try one of its easier weekday rides first. Open to non-members. Helmets, lights when dark, no aero bars, no earphones.

name: SFVBC Saturday Club Ride
schedule: Every Saturday (and Sunday), 8:00 am sharp

start_location.name: CSUN Parking Lot B1
start_location.address: Nordhoff St & Etiwanda Ave, Northridge, CA 91330

pace: ride levels 1–5; beginner no-drop ride the first Saturday of the month
cost: free to ride, membership for full site access
description: A 400-member road club that posts a different ride every Saturday and Sunday from the CSUN lot. Rides are rated 1 to 5 for distance and climbing. The first Saturday of each month is a beginner, no-drop ride. Helmets required; minors with a parent.

name: Venice Electric Light Parade
schedule: Every Sunday at sunset (gathers around 6:35 pm), Venice Beach

start_location.name: Venice Beach
start_location.address: Venice Beach boardwalk, Los Angeles, CA 90291

founded_note: Founded by Marcus Gladney, per the group's site
description: A weekly lit-up night ride along Venice Beach. Any human- or electric-powered ride is welcome, no gas vehicles. Family friendly, no smoking or drinking. Bring lights; wheel lights are not required.

name: Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 9:30 am (roll out 9:35 am), weather permitting
pace: moderate, 14–17 mph average, no-drop with regroups
cost: free, waiver required; club membership encouraged
description: Marin's community cycling club runs a shorter Sunday ride from Equator Coffees in Mill Valley. Moderate pace, 25 to 35 miles, with set regroup points. Not a beginner pace, but no one is dropped. A longer, faster ride leaves from the same spot on Saturdays at 8:30 am.

name: East Bay Bike Party
schedule: Second Friday of every month. Meet 7:30 pm, roll 8:00 pm
description: A themed monthly ride across Oakland, Berkeley and the rest of the East Bay, usually starting at a BART station. Self-supported: bring lights, lock, layers and snacks. Six rules, including stop at lights and stay to the right. Instagram has the most current ride info.

name: Red Bike & Green Community Rides
schedule: First Friday, 6:00 pm, and second Saturday, 12:00 pm
founded_note: Started in Oakland in 2007 by Jenna Burton, per a Grist profile
description: A collective of Black urban cyclists that has ridden during Oakland's First Friday since 2007. The Friday ride draws a younger crowd; the second Saturday ride is family-friendly, with kids and grandparents. Both leave from the Lake Merritt Pergola. Routes stop at Black-owned businesses.

name: Big Wheel Bikes CV Community Group Rides
schedule: Seasonal (Nov–Apr); rides announced on the shop's social media, no fixed weekly slot

start_location.name: Big Wheel Bikes CV, Palm Springs (also Palm Desert flagship)
start_location.address: 1590 S Palm Canyon Dr, Palm Springs, CA 92264

description: An independent Coachella Valley shop that runs guided community group rides, demo days and bike nights during the cool season. The Palm Springs store closes for summer. Rides are announced on Facebook and Instagram rather than a standing schedule.

name: FOO CHOW Ride
schedule: 1st and 3rd Tuesday of the month, meet 6:45 pm, roll 7:00 pm

start_location.name: Incycle Pasadena
start_location.address: 175 S Fair Oaks Ave, Pasadena, CA 91105

pace: medium to spicy, regroups at major turns and tops of climbs
description: Evening shop ride out of Incycle Pasadena twice a month. Pace runs medium to hard, but the group regroups at every major turn and at the top of long climbs. Bring lights, tools, a tube and water. No RSVP; sign the waiver and show up.

name: Shasta Wheelmen Weekday Ride
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays; start time shifts by month (8:00 am in September, 7:00 am in summer, 9:00 am in winter; one hour earlier when the forecast high is 100°F or more)
cost: free with signed waiver; club membership encouraged
description: Redding's road club rides Tuesday and Thursday mornings from the Sundial Bridge lot. A rotating set of 24 numbered routes, 28 to 42 miles, through Old Shasta, Palo Cedro, Anderson and the Shasta Dam loop. Start time moves with the season. Non-members bring a signed waiver. Weekend rides start from other spots and are on the club's Google calendar.

name: Friday Java Ride (Beach Cities Cycling Club)
schedule: Every Friday, 9:00 am (club also rides Saturday 8:00 am, Sunday 9:00 am, Tuesday 9:00 am)

start_location.name: Redondo Beach Pier, pedestrian area south of Captain Kidd's
start_location.address: Harbor Dr & Pacific Ave, Redondo Beach, CA 90277

host.name: Beach Cities Cycling Club, South Bay

description: An easy, flat coffee ride to a cafe or bakery in the South Bay or Westside. The club calls it its most social ride and a good first ride for beginners or people getting back into it. The club has a no-drop policy on all rides and runs 13 activities a week at four levels, most from the Redondo pier.

name: Riverside Bicycle Club Saturday Casual Ride
schedule: Every Saturday (club also rides Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday); times on the club calendar
pace: short, mostly flat, regroup in the middle; A/B/C/D groups on other days
founded_note: Founded 1891, oldest continuous bike club west of the Mississippi, per the club site
cost: free, all club rides open to the public
description: The oldest continuously running bike club west of the Mississippi puts on more than 400 rides a year, all open to the public. The club points beginners to the Saturday Casual Ride, a short flat loop with a regroup to socialize, and the Sunday D group. Start points are on the calendar.

name: Bike Party Sacramento
schedule: First Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
founded_note: Rode its 13th birthday ride in February 2026, per an Abridged / PBS KVIE story
description: A big themed social ride on the first Friday of the month, rain or shine. Hundreds show up with lights, costumes and sound systems. Volunteers plan the route and theme; there are no official leaders, and you ride at your own risk. Start point changes each month and is posted on Facebook and Instagram.

name: Cyclo-Vets Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:30 am (also Wednesday 8:30 am coffee ride and Friday 8:00 am Coronado ride)

start_location.name: Trader Joe's / Coffee Bean lot, Mission Valley
start_location.address: 5010 Mission Center Rd, San Diego, CA 92108

pace: A (hilly, ~50 mi), B+ (~40 mi, no-drop), B Top Gun (~35 mi, mostly flat)
founded_note: Club began in 1984 focused on over-35 riders, per cyclo-vets.com
description: A recreational club that started in 1984 for older riders and now takes all ages. Three Saturday groups leave Mission Valley together; the B rides are no-drop. Approved e-bikes are allowed. There is also a Friday leisurely ferry-and-bikeway ride from Coronado.

name: Moment Bicycles Saturday Point Loma Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:30 am (Tue/Thu 6:30 am and Sunday 8:00 am rides also)

start_location.name: Moment Bicycles
start_location.address: 1891 San Diego Ave, San Diego, CA 92110

pace: two groups; a second group scoops up anyone dropped from the first
description: Saturday shop ride through Point Loma, Harbor Island, downtown, Balboa Park and Mission Bay, with a short and a long option. Two groups roll so nobody rides alone. The shop also runs Tuesday and Thursday 6:30 am hill repeats and a rotating Sunday route.

name: Outspoken Cycle Club San Diego Rides
schedule: Regular open-to-all rides; dates posted on the club's San Diego page and Heylo group
description: A queer and allied nonprofit cycling club with chapters in Seattle and San Diego. It runs open-to-all rides, socials and workshops; rides range from beginner-friendly to all-day. Public events are listed on the San Diego page and the club's Heylo group.

name: SDBC Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, rolls 8:30 am; new-rider orientation 8:15 am

start_location.name: UC Cyclery
start_location.address: 8715 Villa La Jolla Dr #B, La Jolla, CA 92037

pace: 7 groups: A, B, C, and Development D-1 through D-4
founded_note: Saturday rides offered since 1976, per sdbc.org
description: Seven groups roll every Saturday from UC Cyclery, rain or shine, fastest first. First-timers fill out a form, come to the 8:15 orientation and start with a Development group. The D-4 ride is 24 miles and allows pedal-assist e-bikes. Open to the public.

name: SheWolves Ride
schedule: Thursday evenings, 7:15 pm; dates posted on Instagram (reported as monthly)
description: A no-drop evening loop from the fountain in Balboa Park for women, trans, femme, queer, gender-nonconforming and other riders who don't always feel welcome on standard group rides. Sources disagree on whether it runs weekly or monthly, so check Instagram for the next date.

name: Butterlap
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:00 pm (roll out 7:15 pm)
description: A Wednesday night loop around San Francisco that starts at the Ferry Building. There are no leaders. The pace is relaxed and nobody gets dropped. Everyone is welcome.

name: Different Spokes Jersey Ride
schedule: Second Saturday of the month; SF group meets 8:45 am (roll 9:00 am), Sausalito group meets 9:45 am (roll 10:00 am)
cost: free for up to three guest rides, then club membership
description: The monthly club ride of the Bay Area's LGBTQ+ cycling club. Two groups, one from the Castro (48 miles) and one from Mike's Bikes in Sausalito (24 miles), meet in Tiburon for lunch. Straight friends are welcome too. Guests can ride three times before joining.

name: San Francisco Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month, 5:30 pm
founded_note: First ride was September 1992; the 30th anniversary ride was September 2022, per sfcriticalmass.org
description: The original Critical Mass, riding since 1992. No one is in charge and everyone is invited. Gather at the Embarcadero at the foot of Market Street on the last Friday and roll with the crowd. Bring your bike.

name: San Jose Bike Party
schedule: Third Friday of every month, 8:00 pm (meet 7:30 pm)
description: The original Bike Party. Two to four thousand riders on a themed route through the South Bay, one night a month, run by 100 to 200 volunteers. Start point rotates and is posted on the site the week of. Stop at lights, stay right, ride sober.

name: Fastrack Saturday Lake Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am (Sunday Echelon club ride 8:30 am from the Mission)
pace: moderate, regroups at the top of climbs
description: Out through Summerland and up to Lake Casitas and back, 40 to 50 miles with regroups at the top of the climbs. Riders meet afterward at Handlebar Coffee near the shop. Fastrack also lists Tuesday and Thursday 7:00 am rides and the spirited Sunday Echelon ride.

name: Girls Rock Monthly Ride
schedule: One Sunday a month, check-in 8:45 am, roll out 10:00 am (start venue changes; Santa Cruz Mountain Brewing in Sep and Oct 2026)

start_location.name: Varies (Santa Cruz Mountain Brewing for Sep–Oct 2026)

description: A free monthly women's mountain bike ride on Santa Cruz trails. Riders check in, split into groups by level with volunteer guides, and roll out at 10 am. First-timers are welcome. Register online before you come; the start venue changes month to month.

name: BikeVC Brew Ride
schedule: Second Sunday of the month, 1:00 pm, spring through fall
description: A long-standing BikeVC tradition: an easy city ride from the community bike shop to a couple of Ventura breweries, done by about 4 pm. Runs spring, summer and fall, usually the second Sunday. Plans can change, so check the Meetup group.

name: Easy Rider Community Ride
schedule: About twice a month, mornings; dates on the Easy Rider Meetup group

start_location.name: Museum of Ventura County parking lot

pace: 12 mph, with a briefing and bike check at the start

host.name: Channel Islands Bicycle Club and Bike Ventura

description: Free community rides for anyone who can ride 15 miles at about 12 mph. Each ride starts with introductions, a briefing and a bike safety check, so it works as a first group ride. Run jointly by the local club and the bike nonprofit.

name: Adventure Cycling Saturday Morning Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am (summer) / 10:00 am (winter)
description: A 20–30 mile Saturday loop from a southeast Denver-area shop. The pace adjusts to who shows up and nobody gets dropped. Cancelled below 35°F or in rain and snow; the shop posts cancellations on Facebook.

name: Gurlz Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:00 pm
description: A women's intermediate trail ride on Doudy Draw and nearby trails, 10–12 miles with 800–1,000 feet of climbing. Skills and community over speed. No-drop.

name: Knobby Wednesday
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:30 pm
description: The Boulder Mountainbike Alliance's beginner-friendly weekly ride on smooth, non-technical trails. Coed and no-drop: the group stops at every intersection and waits. Good first trail ride.

name: Wednesday Morning Velo
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:30 am, May 20 – Sep 30
founded_note: Started in 2002 as 'The Bankers Ride', per the ride's website
description: A big Boulder business-community ride with six pace groups and free coffee and pastries at Amante afterward. A slower 'Rocky Ride' leaves Amante at 8:30 am. Summer only.

name: Women's Tuesday Group Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm (through mid-October)
description: A women's shop ride on roads, paths and the occasional smooth gravel stretch. Around 13–15 mph, 15–25 miles, and no one gets dropped. Posted weekly on the shop's Meetup.

name: The Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, March 12 – October 29
description: A laid-back evening roll through downtown Colorado Springs. Casual pace, all skill levels, no one left behind. Runs March through October. Start point is posted on Instagram.

name: Tour de Latte
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am, in season

start_location.name: E Fontanero St & N Weber St
start_location.address: 1901 N Weber St, Colorado Springs, CO 80907

founded_note: Club founded 1987, per its Meetup description
cost: first ride free; club membership $30/year after
description: A slow Saturday social ride that stops at a different independent coffee shop each week. Corners are posted and there is a sweep. Distance grows through the season, from about 10 miles in May to 20–25 later on.

name: Denver Cruiser Ride
schedule: Summer season; meet 7:00 pm, kickstands up 7:45 pm (dates via the email list)
founded_note: Started 2005 by Brad Evans, per Wikipedia and the ride's own site footer
description: Denver's costume-theme cruiser ride, running summers since 2005. It started as a weekly Wednesday ride and shifted to a monthly schedule in 2017. Any bike is fine. The current site lists a Tivoli meet-up at 7 pm; join the email list for dates.

name: OUTspokin' Club Rides
schedule: At least weekly, May through September; see the club calendar
pace: green (beginner, no-drop), blue (intermediate, no-drop), black (advanced, may drop)
founded_note: Club describes itself as 'Colorado's original LGBTQ+ Cycling Club since 1998'
description: Colorado's LGBTQ+ cycling club, riding road and gravel around greater Denver. Rides are graded green, blue and black; green and blue are no-drop. Allies welcome. Sign a waiver and try one ride free before joining.

name: RAR Front Range See You Next Tuesday Ride
schedule: A monthly mid-week Tuesday ride, roughly April through fall; dates posted on Instagram
founded_note: Chapter established early 2023, per Radical Adventure Riders
description: The Front Range chapter of Radical Adventure Riders runs a monthly Tuesday evening ride for FTWN-B and BIPOC riders, plus bikepacking trips and an annual gravel camp. Small and friendly; new faces are usual. The chapter's Instagram is the source of truth for dates.

name: The Phoenix Denver Sober Weekend Rides
schedule: Gravel rides on Saturdays, road rides on Sundays; plus a Boulder gravel ride every other Saturday (from March 21, 2026). Times and meet-ups listed in the Phoenix app
founded_note: The Phoenix organization was founded in 2006 in Denver, per its site; no start date is listed for the ride itself
description: The Phoenix is a free sober active community. Its Denver chapter posts weekend bike rides, gravel on Saturdays and road on Sundays, open to anyone with 48 hours of sobriety. Rides are listed in the Phoenix app and events page; the Facebook page announces new routes.

name: Pedal the Peaks Wednesday Shop Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00–8:00 pm

start_location.name: Pedal the Peaks
start_location.address: 598 Main Ave Suite B, Durango, CO 81301

description: A Wednesday evening shop ride from a Main Avenue bike shop in Durango. Listed by the Durango tourism office; the shop's own site does not post the schedule, so call or check Instagram before you go.

name: Fort Collins Gravel People
schedule: Every Tuesday evening, spring through fall; start location posted weekly
pace: no-drop, 13–14 mph, at least one regroup
description: A Tuesday night gravel ride that calls itself intermediate-focused but beginner-friendly. Around 13–14 mph with a regroup or two. Rides usually end at someone's house or a brewery. Start point changes; check Instagram or Strava.

name: OMBA Singletrack Social
schedule: Wednesday evenings, March through August; time and trailhead vary
pace: casual, ability groups with a sweep
description: A casual Wednesday trail ride from the local mountain bike association. Riders split into ability groups, someone sweeps, and nobody gets dropped. Cancelled when trails are muddy. Details on the OMBA calendar and Facebook.

name: SOR (Saturday Open Ride)
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am (shifts with season)

start_location.name: Front Range Community College library parking lot (SW corner)
start_location.address: 4616 S Shields St, Fort Collins, CO 80526

description: Fort Collins' standing Saturday road ride, with a course that changes weekly through the area's classic routes. Intermediate to advanced pace. Finish point changes with the route.

name: Grand Junction CyclePaths Rides
schedule: Member-led rides most weeks; posted on Meetup (recent: Sundays, 8:00 am)
description: An 880-member Meetup club that rides mountain and road at friendly levels around Grand Junction and Fruita. Rides are posted by members rather than on a fixed weekly slot. Unless a listing says otherwise, they are no-drop.

name: Phil's Circuit Ride (Denver Cycling Club Social B Ride)
schedule: Every Wednesday, 8:00 am
season: year-round, weather dependent in fall and winter

start_location.name: Reynolds Landing
start_location.address: 6745 S Santa Fe Dr, Littleton, CO 80120

description: A weekday morning road ride along the Platte greenway and C-470 with optional detours to Dinosaur Ridge and Red Rocks depending on who shows. Run by a volunteer from the Denver Cycling Club and posted on Meetup.

name: Spin Into the Setting Sun (SVCG Tuesday Night Ride)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:30 pm (B3 group 5:00 pm), spring through late September

host.name: St Vrain Chain Gang Bicycling Club

founded_note: Meetup listing calls 2026 'Season #14' of the weekly Tuesday ride, which implies a 2013 start
description: A Tuesday evening road ride from a Longmont brewery with four pace groups, so there is a slot for most riders. Distance shrinks as sunsets get earlier. The B2 group is explicitly no-drop with regroup points.

name: MMB Tuesday Ride at Monument Preserve
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:30 pm, May through October
description: An after-work trail ride north of Colorado Springs with moderate technical terrain. The group is upfront that it is not a beginner club. Post-ride hangout at Routes Outfitters. The same group runs a mellower Thursday ride at Black Forest Regional Park.

name: Danny's Cycles Darien Kids' Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 2:00 pm
description: A Sunday afternoon skills ride for kids from the Darien shop. All skill levels. Closed-toed shoes and long pants or knee protection required. Fair-weather only.

name: Pedal Power Saturday Morning Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am
pace: B (30–40 mi) and C (20–30 mi) groups
description: An un-led Saturday shop ride from the rear lot of Pedal Power in Middletown. B and C groups, no support vehicle. Pedal Power's Tuesday Middletown and Wednesday Essex rides wrap up mid-September; this one keeps going.

name: Pedal Power Sunday Beginner Ride
schedule: Sundays, 2:00 pm; start point rotates around the Middletown area
description: A Sunday afternoon ride for people new to riding in a group. Start point rotates around central Connecticut; the shop posts the week's location on its ride page. Easy pace, everyone regroups.

name: New Haven Bicycling Club Tuesday & Thursday Evening Rides
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 5:30 pm, March–November

start_location.name: Wilbur Cross High School parking lot

cost: free with annual waiver; membership available
description: Twice-weekly evening rides from Wilbur Cross High School, ending at P&M Market on Orange Street for a drink on the curb. Several pace groups, including two beginner-friendly ones. Some groups drop, some don't; pick accordingly.

name: Thirsty Thursdays Slow Roll
schedule: Third Thursday of the month; slow roll gathers 6:30 pm, social at GastroPark 7–9 pm

start_location.name: Asylum Ave and the Trout Brook Trail

description: A monthly slow roll along the Trout Brook Trail that picks people up along the way and ends at GastroPark for the social hour. Run by the town's bike-walk-transit advocacy group. Any bike, any pace.

name: DC Bike Party
schedule: Second Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
description: A free monthly group ride through the streets of DC with hundreds of riders, music and a theme. Start location changes and is posted on social media before each ride. All bikes and riders welcome.

name: DC Queer Bike Rides
schedule: Twice a month: second Saturday at 12:00 pm and fourth Thursday at 6:30 pm
description: A sober social ride for queer people in DC. Flat routes, quiet streets, a pace where you can still talk. Start points rotate between spots like Alethia Tanner Park, Fort Totten Metro and the Anacostia River Trail, all near Capital Bikeshare stations. No alcohol, no cops, no transphobes.

name: Monday Moves (District Cycling Collective)
schedule: Mondays, 10:00 am (rolls 10:15)
description: A weekday-morning city tour from Conte's in Navy Yard. Routes hit the monuments or run the trails out to National Harbor. Built for newer riders, nobody gets left behind. The same group also runs a faster Wednesday paceline in Anacostia Park.

name: OutRiders DC Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Thursday evenings after work, summer series; plus a Tuesday afternoon ride from Virginia Square Metro and weekend rides
founded_note: Meetup page cites a June 2013 Washington Blade piece on the club's debut as an Arlington-based LGBTQ cycling club
description: A metro DC cycling group for LGBTQ+ people and allies. The summer Thursday series is a casual after-work ride on trails and streets, with an optional dinner after. Weekend rides run longer, 25 to 65 miles. Check Meetup for the exact start each week.

name: Sunday No-Drop Group Bike Rides (DC Tri Club)
schedule: Sundays, intros 8:30 am, ride at 8:45 am (April through summer)
description: Volunteer-led no-drop rides for people learning to ride in a group. Regroup points and a sweep on every ride. Start points move around the DMV and are posted a week ahead in the club's Sunday Bike Rides group. Routes repeat monthly so you can join any time.

name: Wednesday Dogfish Head Ride (Sussex Cyclists)
schedule: Wednesdays, 9:00 am
description: A weekday-morning road ride from the brewery lot in Milton, a few miles inland from Rehoboth and Lewes. Two pace groups, 16 and 17 mph. The club also runs a faster 45-mile Tuesday drop paceline from the same spot.

name: North Wilmington Flat Ride (White Clay Bicycle Club)
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00–8:00 pm
founded_note: Club site says it is in its 51st year as of 2026
description: A Tuesday evening flat road ride in North Wilmington from one of the region's oldest clubs. The club's Thursday North Wilmington Hills ride leaves at the same time for people who want climbing. Exact start point and pace are on the club's ride calendar.

name: Trek Clermont Saturday Group Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am
description: A weekly shop ride from the Trek store in Clermont, in the hills west of Orlando. About two and a half hours, 26 to 33 miles, route decided by the group. Details on the shop's Facebook events.

name: EBC / Bike 305 Beginner Ride
schedule: Second Saturday of the month, 7:30 am
description: A ten-mile intro ride for people who have never ridden in a group. Slow pace, short distance, same start as the main club ride. Run once a month with the county's Bike 305 program.

name: Everglades Bicycle Club Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am
founded_note: Club marked 50 years in 2024–2026 per its homepage
description: Miami's oldest road club. Saturday training rides leave the middle school across from UM in several pace groups. New riders are asked to read the ride guide first and sit at the back on their first ride. The club also runs a short beginner ride on the second Saturday.

name: Fort Lauderdale Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of the month, 7:30 pm
description: Large social ride around Fort Lauderdale on the last Friday of every month. A few hundred riders on every kind of bike. Slow pace. Starts at Holiday Park. The same Facebook group also lists a smaller Sunday night slow ride from Esplanade Park.

name: The Goonie Prowl
schedule: Every Friday, meet 7:30 pm, pedals 8:00 pm
description: Friday night social ride out of a brewery. Slow pace, stops for beer and food, any bike works. Bring lights.

name: RAM Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: Under the Fuller Warren Bridge, Riverside

description: Easy Saturday morning ride that starts under the Fuller Warren Bridge in Riverside, near the Riverside Arts Market. Listed by ZenCog as one of the city's regular community rides.

name: TuNiBiRi (Tuesday Night Bike Ride)
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 9:00–9:30 pm, roll 10:00 pm
description: Late Tuesday night urban ride in Jacksonville, about two hours at a social clip. Listed by ZenCog bike shop among the city's community rides. Bring lights.

name: Village Idiots Wednesday Night Worlds
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm (March–October)

start_location.name: Village Bikes Lakewood Ranch
start_location.address: 8111 Lakewood Main St, Lakewood Ranch, FL 34202

description: Sarasota-Bradenton's Wednesday evening ride. Seven groups from a 26-plus hammerfest down to a 14–16 mph no-drop group, so there is a spot for most people. Thirty miles, then the pub on Main Street.

name: Miami Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month. Gather 6:30 pm, ride 7:15 pm

host.name: Miami Critical Mass (info via The Miami Bike Scene)

description: A monthly mass ride from Government Center downtown through Miami neighborhoods, often out to Miami Beach and back. Around 20 miles. Front and rear lights required by Florida law. The Miami Bike Scene posts each month's route.

name: Kyle's Bike Shop Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:00 pm
description: Long-running Orlando shop ride. Four rotating routes of roughly 30 to 36 miles, split into A through D groups, with a mid-ride stop. Lights and helmets required. Show up 30 minutes early.

name: Bike Pensacola Slow Ride
schedule: Monthly, usually a Friday evening around 6:00 pm; dates and start point posted on Facebook
description: A monthly slow ride through Pensacola's historic neighborhoods that draws a few hundred people. Five or six miles in about an hour. Beginners, kids and cruisers are the norm. The start location moves; check Facebook.

name: Sanford Bicycle Club Monday Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Deviant Wolfe / Dees Brothers Brewery area, downtown Sanford

description: Relaxed hour-long loop from a downtown Sanford brewery. No-drop, any bike. Listed by the local shop as the town's easy Monday ride.

name: Sanford's Saturday Social Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, meet 7:15 am, roll 7:30 am
description: Shop ride around the Lake Monroe loop, 28 miles in two pace groups. Route is on Ride with GPS. The shop also runs a monthly recumbent ride and a monthly gravel night ride.

name: Tuesday Dunedin Breakfast Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 8:00 am (8:30 am late Oct–late Apr)
description: A no-drop weekday ride up the Pinellas Trail to Dunedin for breakfast and back. Thirty miles at a relaxed pace with an optional bridge sprint for anyone who wants it.

name: St. Pete Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of the month, gather 7:00 pm, roll 7:30 pm
description: Monthly social ride through downtown St. Pete at 10 to 12 mph for about an hour. Helmets and lights strongly encouraged. Meets at the fountain in Williams Park.

name: St. Petersburg Bicycle Club Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am (8:30 am from Oct 31)

start_location.name: North Shore Aquatic Center
start_location.address: 901 N Shore Dr NE, St. Petersburg, FL 33701

description: The club's main ride and the one it tells new people to start with. Pick a speed group at the pool and go north to Weedon Island or south to Pinellas Point. Slower groups are no-drop. No membership needed. Helmets required; no tri-bars in the group.

name: South Broward Wheelers Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am
founded_note: Founding year stated on the club's website
description: Club ride from Markham Park with three groups: intermediate, experienced and advanced. Routes go out on WhatsApp. Trial rides are welcome before you join.

name: Saturday Classic Chaires
schedule: Every Saturday (time on club calendar)
description: The Tallahassee club's standing Saturday ride, 31 miles on the rolling roads east of town. Regroups regularly. Helmet required, no aero bars. Start time is posted on the club calendar and shifts with the season.

name: BikeAthens Joy Ride
schedule: Last Friday of the month, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: BikeAthens shop (under Daily Groceries)
start_location.address: 1190 Prince Ave Suite B, Athens, GA 30606

description: Slow in-town ride from the BikeAthens community shop. Six to eight miles on streets and multi-use paths with a ride leader up front and a sweeper in back. Nobody gets left. Optional hang at Athentic Brewing after.

name: Critical Mass Atlanta
schedule: Last Friday of every month, 6:30 pm
description: Atlanta's biggest monthly ride. Meets at Woodruff Park downtown on the last Friday, 10 to 15 miles on a rotating route. Beginner-friendly. Organized through a Facebook group.

name: Midweek Roll
schedule: Every other Wednesday, meet 7:00 pm, roll 7:30 pm
description: A slow social loop through intown Atlanta neighborhoods that starts and ends at a bar. Ten to twelve miles at a talking pace. Helmets and lights required. Runs every other Wednesday; check Instagram for the next date.

name: Motivation Monday (Bonafide CC)
schedule: Every Monday, meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:15 pm
description: Bonafide's easiest weeknight ride. Twenty-plus miles on the flatter side of town, aimed at people newer to group riding. Helmet and front and rear lights required. Meets at the Inman Park train station.

name: Outspokin' Friday Canal Ride
schedule: Every Friday, 6:00 pm
description: Easy out-and-back on the Augusta Canal towpath. About 20 miles at a talking pace on a mountain, gravel or hybrid bike. Runs through winter too; bring lights once it gets dark early.

name: Wednesday Worlds
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:10 pm (March–October)
description: Augusta's fast Wednesday ride. Race pace, and you can get dropped. Route is posted on the shop's Instagram or Facebook by noon each Wednesday. In winter the shop swaps it for an indoor trainer session.

name: Pizza Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Art Lot
start_location.address: 70 N Avondale Rd, Avondale Estates, GA 30002

description: One of the long-running Atlanta road rides. Leaves the Art Lot in Avondale Estates Thursday evenings and splits into groups by pace and distance. Runs year-round. Pizza afterward is the point.

name: Brookhaven Bike Alliance Monday Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm
description: Neighborhood no-drop ride with two options: a 13-mile loop at an easy pace or a 20-mile loop a bit quicker. Good first group ride if you live north of the city.

name: Bike Roswell! Wednesday Evening Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:30 pm

start_location.name: Roswell United Methodist Church parking lot
start_location.address: Corner of Magnolia St and Mimosa Blvd, Roswell, GA 30075

pace: A 18+ mph, B 16–17 mph, C 14–15 mph
description: Volunteer-run community ride in Roswell. Twenty to twenty-five miles in pace groups; leaders stay with anyone who falls off. Waiver required. Check the Facebook group to confirm the ride is on.

name: Perry Rubber Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, meet 7:30 am, roll 8:00 am
description: The shop's anchor ride. Leaves from Bull Street at 8 sharp every Saturday and, per the shop, is only cancelled for a hurricane. Riders of all ages and abilities are welcome. The shop also runs Monday and Wednesday evening rides at 6 pm.

name: Pau Hana Wednesday (Outta Bounds)
schedule: Every Wednesday, 4:30 pm sharp

start_location.name: Triangle Park (Fort Ruger Park), east of Diamond Head

pace: fast, 18+ mph, regroup points and a designated sweeper
description: A fast after-work ride from Diamond Head out toward Hanauma Bay, Sandy's or Makapu'u depending on the season. The pace is 18-plus but the route is fixed, there are regular regroups and a sweeper so nobody is left behind. Refreshments back at the park.

name: Red Hot Ladies Roving Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, meet 7:15 am, roll 7:30 am; start location varies (Cruisers and Cosmos beginner rides also Sunday 8:30 am)
description: A women's riding group under the Hawaii Bicycling League. The Sunday Roving Ride is a moderate no-drop ride of 20 to 50 miles with a rotating start; the Cruisers and Cosmos rides the same morning are shorter, beginner-friendly options. Contact the leader for the week's start.

name: Start the Week Off Right
schedule: Every Monday, 8:30 am to about noon

start_location.name: Kahala Community Center
start_location.address: Moa St & Pahoa Ave, Honolulu, HI 96816

description: A Monday morning beginner ride from Kahala out to the Hawaii Kai hills, sometimes Sandy Beach, with a Starbucks stop before heading back. Fifteen to 20 miles at an easy pace. Listed by the Hawaii Bicycling League with a volunteer leader.

name: Wolfpack Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 4:30 pm
pace: fast; drop ride on the return
description: A 25-mile fast Tuesday evening ride from Kilauea District Park, listed by the Hawaii Bicycling League as an advanced ride. It's a drop ride on the way back, so know the route home.

name: Kona Saturday Recreational Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am (also Tuesday 7:00 am)

start_location.name: Kailua-Kona Target parking lot, NW corner

pace: casual no-drop tempo, 13–20 mph, rolling hills

host.name: Kona recreational riders (listed by Hawaii Cycling Club)

description: A casual no-drop ride north on Highway 19 from the Target lot in Kona, with turnarounds at Kua Bay, the scenic overlook or the Waikoloa shops. E-bikes welcome. The Hawaii Cycling Club lists it as a courtesy; it is an informal meet-up with no ride leader.

name: Sunday Morning Coffee Jam
schedule: Every Sunday, meet 7:00 am, roll 7:15 am
pace: fast social group, no-drop, all abilities
description: A west-side Oahu Sunday ride, 35 to 40 miles, that calls itself a fast social group but is no-drop and open to all abilities. Route map is on the HBL listing. Organized through a Facebook group.

name: Maui Bicycling League Monthly Group Ride
schedule: Once a month, usually a Saturday morning; location varies (e.g., Kalama Park, Kihei); registration required
pace: intermediate 12–14 mph, some rides with a 10–12 mph beginner option
description: Maui's bike advocacy nonprofit hosts one group ride a month to bring local riders together, capped at 30 people with pre-registration. Routes change; a past one ran Kihei to Iao Valley and Wailuku with live music at the coffee stop. E-bikes welcome, helmets required.

name: Monday Night No-Drop Road Ride (MNNDR)
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm sharp, from the start of Daylight Saving Time to Labor Day

start_location.name: Great Western Trail trailhead
start_location.address: 4343 George Flagg Pkwy, Des Moines, IA 50321

pace: ~17 mph average, conversational; riders should be able to hold 14 mph

host.name: Sakari / Smart Honda Race Team members

description: A 20-mile no-drop road ride with regroup points, led by members of a local race team. Weekly prize drawings from sponsors. Listed on the DSM Group Rides calendar alongside the Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday rides.

name: Prairie Burner Weekly Gravel Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:30 pm
pace: routes posted ahead; shorter options some weeks
description: A small-town weekly gravel ride from the Bikes To You shop, ending at Grinnell Craft Brewhouse. 20 to 25 miles on posted routes. Free loaner bikes through the Grinnell Bike Share. Not sure about gravel? The same group runs a shorter Gravel Curious ride Thursdays at 5:30 pm.

name: Bicyclists of Iowa City Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, April–September

start_location.name: Varies (Quinton's, Flannigan's, North Liberty, Solon); see the BIC calendar

founded_note: Club page lists 1976 as its founding year
description: A weeknight loop ride of 18 to 28 miles with fewer stops than the club's social rides. Start point rotates among a few bars and nearby towns. BIC also runs Monday relaxed-pace rides for new riders, Tuesday morning rides and Saturday rides of 20 to 100 miles.

name: Friday Night Ride – Gatos en Ronda
schedule: Every Friday, 6:00 pm
description: An intermediate-level Friday ride from the community bike shop. No-drop, so nobody gets left behind. The Bike Library also runs beginner-friendly rides on trails and back ways.

name: Sugar Bottom Bikes Wednesday Night Gravel
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 5:50 pm, roll 6:10 pm, April 22–October 14
description: A weekly gravel ride from the shop with three pace groups. The shop also hosts Tuesday Trails, a casual social ride of the Sugar Bottom mountain bike trails, and winter fat bike rides.

name: Lactic Acid Cycling Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday. 10:00 am Oct–Apr, 9:00 am May and Sep, 8:00 am Jun–Aug

start_location.name: LuLu's Pizza
start_location.address: 2594 N Bogus Basin Rd, Boise, ID 83702

pace: A group 18–22 mph, B group 16–18 mph
cost: free to try; club membership and ride waiver required to keep riding
description: The club's main weekly road ride. A and B groups usually roll from LuLu's Pizza on Bogus Basin Rd, and the start time shifts with the season. Long group goes 65 to 100 miles, short group 34 to 65. Rides and any start changes are announced by club forum email and on the club Facebook group.

name: Mountain Mondays
schedule: Mondays, 5:30 pm, most weeks during the school year
season: late Aug–early Nov and late Mar–May; summer rides weather dependent
description: Free all-levels mountain bike ride from the campus bike shop into the Boise foothills. New riders get trail technique, trailside repair basics and an intro to the Ridge to Rivers trails. Runs from the start of fall semester until the time change, then again late March to May. Dates are posted on the shop's Instagram.

name: Tuesday Classic
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:30 pm (spring–summer)

start_location.name: Workhorse office
start_location.address: 1324 E Sherman Ave, Coeur d'Alene, ID 83814

founded_note: Club founded 2019, per cdacycling.club About section
cost: free to ride after signing the waiver; $25 annual membership (2026)
description: Weeknight road ride from the Workhorse office on East Sherman. Around 18 mph. The club also runs a Thursday flats ride, a Friday morning coffee ride and a Saturday noon ride from the same spot. Anyone can ride after signing the club's safety waiver.

name: Tuesday Night Easy Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, April to about September 10

host.name: Idaho Cycling Enthusiasts (I.C.E.) with Barrie's Ski and Sports

description: A beginner road ride out Fort Hall Mine Road and back, about 17 miles. Someone on the ride will help with seat height, shifting, flats and posture. No-drop and paced to whoever shows up. I.C.E. membership is $10 and can be bought at the shop before the ride. The same club and shop run a Thursday night no-drop ride for all levels.

name: Prairie Cycle Club Wednesday Evening Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday evening, mid-April through Labor Day

start_location.name: Start varies; see the club ride page

founded_note: Club says it was founded in 1971, per prairiecycleclub.org
description: The club's easiest evening ride: 12 to 14 miles at 9–12 mph. Good for people new to riding on the road. The club also runs a Monday Mahomet ride (12–15 mph), a Tuesday morning ride, a fast Thursday evening ride (16–20 mph) and a Saturday morning ride.

name: BFF Bikes Beginner/Intermediate Ride
schedule: Sundays, alternating with the shop's Endurance Ride (check the calendar)
description: A casual no-drop cruise around the city for people who have never done a group ride. No experience needed. On the off weeks the shop's Endurance Ride goes 30–50 miles at 16–18 mph.

name: BFF Bikes Thursday WTF Social Ride
schedule: Thursdays (check the shop calendar for dates)
description: A short party-pace ride for women, trans and femme riders from the Bucktown shop. 8 to 10 miles, very beginner friendly. The shop also runs a Sunday beginner/intermediate no-drop cruise and a faster Sunday endurance ride of 30–50 miles.

name: Chicago Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month. Gather 5:30 pm, leave around 6:00–6:15 pm
description: Thousands of riders leave Daley Plaza on the last Friday of every month, rain, shine or snow. Music, costumes, and a different route each time. Anyone on non-motorized wheels is welcome.

name: Femmes + Thems Bike Chi Monthly Social Ride
schedule: First Saturday of every month (typically); weeknight night rides and quarterly trans and gender-diverse rides too
description: A ride for women, femme, trans and non-binary Chicagoans. Five to fifteen miles at about 10 mph, with marshals in purple vests blocking intersections. Beginners welcome; nobody gets left behind. Check the calendar for the exact date and start.

name: Southside Critical Mass
schedule: First Friday of every month, 6:15 pm
description: The South Side's own Critical Mass, on the first Friday instead of the last. Listed in the Chicago Group Rides directory; check the Facebook page for each month's start point.

name: Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Big Ring
schedule: Tuesdays through the season, 6:00 pm sharp to 7:30 pm

start_location.name: Bartel Grasslands
start_location.address: Central Ave & Flossmoor Rd, Tinley Park, IL 60477

pace: A group 20+ mph, B group 17–18 mph
description: MTC3's signature Tuesday paceline ride in the south suburbs. A group drops, B group holds together if you keep the pace. The club, named for the first Black world cycling champion, runs rides nearly every day of the week from the South Side and suburbs, including a weekday Sunrise ride and a slower Tuesday Slow Your Roll.

name: Wednesday World pb Bloomington Bicycles
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: E Kirkwood Ave & S Indiana Ave
start_location.address: E Kirkwood Ave & S Indiana Ave, Bloomington, IN 47405

description: Bloomington's fast Wednesday ride, with a rotation of five routes called out on the day. Little 500 riders and local strong riders show up. Not a beginner ride.

name: 3RVS Monday Morning Meandering and Musings
schedule: Every Monday, 10:00 am, from early May; start varies (see club calendar)
founded_note: Club founded 1969, per its About page
description: A women-only slow ride on city streets and trails with a mid-ride refreshment stop. Made for people fairly new to the bike or coming back after a long time off.

name: 3RVS Wednesday D Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:15 pm, from early May

start_location.name: Alternates between Huntertown Elementary and Arcola Elementary (check the club calendar)

pace: D pace, 14–15 mph, slower if the group wants
founded_note: Club founded 1969, per its About page
description: Built for riders of different skill levels and welcoming to people newer to group riding. Fifteen to twenty-five miles at an easy D pace, dialed back when needed.

name: The Bike Line Tuesday & Thursday Road Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 7:00 pm
pace: fast group ~23 mph, slower group ~18 mph
description: A marked ~22 mile road route from the Broad Ripple shop. Not a no-drop ride, but it usually splits into a fast group and a more leisurely one.

name: Bikes and Brews (formerly the Rollout)
schedule: Every Thursday, May–August; arrive 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm sharp

start_location.name: The old 7-11
start_location.address: 501 E LaSalle Ave, South Bend, IN 46617

pace: social ride, MTB ride and a faster road ride each week
description: South Bend's Thursday night ride series with three options: a social ride, a mountain bike ride and a faster road ride. Everyone meets up at The Lauber afterward.

name: MBA Monday Leisure Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm, April–September and beyond if weather allows
description: A hosted leisure ride from Pinhook Park. Ten to seventeen miles at 10–13 mph, and the group always stays together. Distance grows through the season.

name: BRBC Monday Social Ride
schedule: Every Monday, gather 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm, March–September
cost: free to try, no membership required
description: A relaxed 15-mile loop through the neighborhoods around Mission Farms, good for recovery days and for beginners. A sweep rider holds 12 mph so nobody is left. The club's Saturday rides are faster: a 7:15 am coffee ride and a 9 am 40-mile drop ride with regroups.

name: KVBC Dover Dogs
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm, spring through fall

start_location.name: Western Hills Church, 29th & Auburn Rd
start_location.address: SW 29th St & SW Auburn Rd, Topeka, KS 66614

pace: mixed group that splits by speed and regroups in Dover
description: A 20-mile out-and-back to the town of Dover on the west edge of Topeka. The group splits by speed and everyone regroups in Dover. All welcome. Bring lights in case the sun gets low.

name: KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:10 pm, spring through fall (starts early May)

start_location.name: Washburn University parking lot, SW 20th & MacVicar
start_location.address: SW 20th St & SW MacVicar Ave, Topeka, KS 66604

description: A 15-mile round trip on streets and trails for beginner and intermediate riders. E-bikes welcome. Often stops for ice cream near the end. Helmets and a good attitude required. Check the club's calendar or Facebook for start and end dates.

name: BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride
schedule: Mondays, 5:30–7:30 pm, in season

start_location.name: Warren County Bike Safety Park at the Fringe

host.name: BikeWalkBG / City-County Planning Commission of Warren County

description: A free women's community ride organized by the county's BikeWalkBG program from the downtown bike safety park. Family rides and a monthly seniors ride run from the same spot.

name: RideTheCov Wednesday Series
schedule: 2nd and 4th Wednesdays, 6:00 pm, late March through October
description: Short, easy rides through the river cities to get people on bikes. A quick safety check and tire pump before rolling. Group riding basics explained at the start. Helmets suggested.

name: First Friday Social Ride
schedule: First Friday of the month, 6:00 pm
description: A family-friendly five-to-eight mile ride around downtown Lexington that ends at a local brewery. Casual pace, everyone welcome.

name: Pedal Power x Country Boy Community Bike Ride
schedule: 2nd and 4th Wednesdays; meet 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm
description: A casual loop around town from Country Boy Brewing, then back for the shop's happy hour. Nobody gets left behind. Cancelled if it rains.

name: Monnik Monday Recovery Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:15 pm sharp, year-round
founded_note: See Ridenfaden Wednesday
description: A really slow recovery ride from Monnik in Schnitzelburg. Ten to fifteen miles at ten to fifteen mph, then a discounted pint back at the brewery.

name: Ridenfaden Wednesday
schedule: Every Wednesday, year-round; no-drop group 6:00 pm, fast ride 6:30 pm
pace: no-drop group and a fast group
founded_note: Two friends' post-ride beers at Seidenfaden's in 2009 grew into the group; the name Ridenfaden dates to 2015, per the About page
description: A year-round Wednesday ride out of a Germantown bar, with a no-drop group at 6 and a fast ride at 6:30. Everyone ends up back at Seidenfaden's by 8. Some race, some slow roll, all fine.

name: The Outsiders Wednesday Social Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:45 pm
founded_note: Founded 2023 by Jef and Brendan, per the club's About page
description: Louisville's largest social ride. Every rider, every bike, no one left behind. Ten to twenty miles at a conversational pace with rotating stops around the city.

name: Downtown East Social Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm (weather permitting)

start_location.name: Outside City Roots at Electric Depot

founded_note: Started 2019 by Samantha Morgan, per 225 Magazine
description: A Monday evening ride through Downtown East that tells the neighborhood's history as it goes. Seven to 10 miles at the pace of the slowest rider. Free and open to everyone; lights are required by state law and the group hands out free ones.

name: Geaux Ride Thursday Night Community Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, meet 7:30 pm, roll 7:45 pm, back by 9:30 pm
cost: free with your own bike; rentals available
description: A free Thursday night cruise through downtown Baton Rouge with lights and music. Bring your own bike or rent one from Geaux Ride. Family friendly. Street parking or the garage at 3rd and Main.

name: Bike Lafayette Saturday Community Ride
schedule: Second and last Saturday of each month; details on Facebook
founded_note: Bike Lafayette founded 2007, per The Advocate; the ride's own start date is not stated
description: Twice a month the advocacy nonprofit Bike Lafayette hosts a community ride around town. Start point and time are posted on the Bike Lafayette Facebook page. The same page lists partner rides like Lafayette Critical Mass and Krewe de Velo.

name: Get Up N Ride Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday evening
founded_note: Riding every Tuesday since October 2015, per Momentum Mag's coverage of New Orleans social rides
description: A three-hour Tuesday social ride through New Orleans with music and stops. Now also a bike lifestyle brand that runs tours and rentals. Check Instagram for the week's start.

name: NOLA Social Ride Happy Thursday
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:00 pm meet, ride leaves 8:00 pm. Start rotates by week of the month (Uptown, Mid-City and more)
founded_note: Helping people discover fun on bikes since 2010, per the group's Facebook page
description: A slow cruise through a different part of New Orleans every Thursday, ending at a local bar. Bring speakers, lights and a smile; costumes are common. The website was down when checked, so use the Facebook group for the weekly start spot.

name: NOLA Social Ride Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday night; start posted weekly on Facebook
founded_note: Riding since 2010, per the group's Facebook page description in search results
description: New Orleans' long-running Thursday night social ride. Themed routes, a slow pace, and a bar or park at the end. The start point changes, so check the Facebook page that week.

name: SB Rides LED Night Ride
schedule: Select evenings, roughly every week or two in summer, 8:00 pm; dates on Instagram
founded_note: Started 2019 by Greg Powell, per Visit Shreveport-Bossier
description: A two-hour night cruise on LED-lit beach cruisers through downtown Shreveport with a couple of bar stops. Built for people who do not own a bike or have not ridden in years. Ages 21 and up. Dates are posted a few weeks at a time.

name: Shreveport Bicycle Club Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am; also Tuesday and Thursday rides
description: The local road club's Saturday ride from a church lot in southeast Shreveport. The club also rides Tuesdays and Thursdays. Check the club Facebook page for the week's route and any changes.

name: Boston Bike Party
schedule: Second Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
founded_note: Brought to Boston in 2013 by Elodie Garcia after riding with DC Bike Party, per the About Us page
description: A monthly social group ride at a casual pace, volunteer-run and free. Around a thousand riders on a good night. Meets at Copley Square unless a post says otherwise. All ages, all bikes.

name: Landry's Boston Slow Roll Social Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm, spring through mid-September (2026 season ended 9/14)
description: A ten-mile Monday evening social ride with a snack stop in the middle. Built for hybrid bikes and people who don't own spandex. Arrive fifteen minutes early for the safety talk; flashing lights required. Seasonal; the 2026 run ended September 14.

name: Conte's Sunday Ride p/b B2C2
schedule: Every Sunday, 9:00 am sharp
description: One ride, four groups. The S group is a team time trial that drops; A and B are no-drop within their pace; C is strictly no-drop and meant for people new to group riding. Riders from the south can join the team rolling from the Uncle Sam statue in Arlington at 8:30. Coffee at the shop after.

name: The Judy Jam
schedule: Mondays, 5:30 pm, mid-April to mid-September
description: Riverside's Monday night no-drop ride with a sweeper, led by Judy. Two groups, sixteen to twenty-four miles on the North Shore. The shop also runs a faster Tuesday ride, a Wednesday gravel ride and a Thursday MTB ride out of Manchester-by-the-Sea. Details come by weekly email.

name: Northampton Cycling Club Wednesday A/B Ride
schedule: Wednesday evenings, April–September; start time on the club calendar
pace: 15–18 mph together to Hatfield, then A and B split
cost: free for two trial rides, then club membership
description: The club's long-running Wednesday ride rolls out of downtown, up Route 9 and over to Hatfield at a conversational pace, then the A group goes. Expect real climbing, 2,000 to 6,000 feet. Routes change weekly and are posted for GPS. Newcomers are steered to the Monday introductory ride first.

name: Seven Hills Wheelmen Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 5:30 pm (moves to 5:30 pm from Sept 22 as daylight shortens), late April onward
description: A 23-mile Tuesday evening loop through the hills west of Worcester, from the school lot in Paxton. Moderate pace. The Wheelmen keep a public list of a dozen other recurring rides across central Massachusetts and the Quiet Corner of Connecticut.

name: GBNEMBA Tuesday Western Greenway Social Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00–8:00 pm
description: A weekly social trail ride on the Western Greenway, Beaver Brook and Lone Tree Hill network, leaving from a brewery. Several paces, no-drop. The chapter also runs a Monday beginner ride and a Tuesday women and gender-expansive ride with Hustle Hive; check the chapter page for those.

name: Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:00 pm, weather permitting

start_location.name: Hale Reservation, Cat Rock Field lot

host.name: Landry's Bicycles with SE MA NEMBA

description: A weekly trail ride for women and gender-expansive riders at Hale, run by Landry's Needham with SE MA NEMBA. Intermediate level: rocks, roots, ninety minutes of steady riding with regroups. Supportive and no-drop. Location can change; check the page weekly.

name: Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling)
schedule: Sundays; 8:00 am summer, 9:00 am spring/fall, 10:00 am winter

start_location.name: Prince George St at USNA Barry Gate

description: A team-hosted no-drop road ride from downtown Annapolis with many regroup points. Thirty-five to forty-five miles at 16 to 18 mph. Start time moves with the season. The team's Saturday ride from Davidsonville is faster and only the B group waits.

name: Baltimore Bike Party
schedule: Last Friday of every month, gather 6:30 pm, roll 7:00 pm
description: A monthly mass slow roll through Baltimore. All ages, all bikes, no registration. The route changes every month and is posted a day or two before. Rides under West Coast rules, stopping at red lights, and ends around 9 at an after-party.

name: Taco Tuesday Ride
schedule: Tuesdays; meet spot and time posted in the Facebook group each week
description: A weekly Tuesday social ride in Baltimore that ends at a taco spot. The group polls its Facebook members on where to eat, then rides there. Listed on Bikemore's community ride roundup. Check the group for that week's start.

name: Sunday Shop Ride (Bethesda Bike & Ski)
schedule: Sundays, meet 8:45 am, roll 9:00 am
description: A 28-mile loop from the shop at a steady 15 mph with a coffee stop at Colada's in Cabin John. Rides start and end at the shop. Email the shop to get added to the WhatsApp group.

name: Thursday Parvilla Shop Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 5:30 pm, April to mid-October
pace: recovery pace; A/B split after 5 miles
description: A 23-mile evening shop ride south of Annapolis, billed as recovery and enjoyment rather than training. The group splits into A and B after the first five miles. Runs spring through mid-October.

name: Sunday Ride from Monocacy Middle School (Frederick Pedalers)
schedule: Sundays, 9:30 am
description: A no-cue-sheet ride that wanders the west side of Route 15, a slightly different way each week. The club calls itself friendly and it is club policy not to drop a rider. Start time shifts with the season; check the ride calendar.

name: Goon Ride
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 6:30 pm, March–September
description: One of the hardest and fastest drop rides in the DC area, per DC Paceline. Twice a week from Veirs Mill Park during daylight-savings months. Not a beginner ride. Bring lights and know the route.

name: CycleMania Thursday Night Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm
description: An all-inclusive Thursday night ride on Portland's in-town trails, leaving from the shop. Bring a mountain bike; that's the only requirement. Call the shop with questions.

name: Gorham Bike & Ski Friday Morning Coffee Shop Road Ride
schedule: Fridays, 8:00 am, first Friday in May through last Friday in November
pace: talking pace out, can get spirited on the way back
description: A Friday morning ride at talking pace up to Yarmouth for coffee and something to eat, then back to Portland. Road bikes only. Has been known to keep going through winter when the roads allow.

name: Mellow Monday Ride
schedule: 2nd and 4th Mondays; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:10 pm, back by ~7:20
description: A short ride for new riders and people getting back on a bike. Back Cove to Payson Park, snacks, a few short skills workshops, then back. Gear Hub is Portland's nonprofit community bike shop. Bring lights and a helmet.

name: Portland Gear Hub Thursday Group Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm; four rotating routes by week of the month
description: A social-pace road ride north or south of the peninsula with ice cream or beach stops. Four routes rotate by week: Higgins Beach, Falmouth, Kettle Cove, Tuttle Loop. There is no sweep, so know the route and be able to fix a flat. Ride whatever bike you have.

name: Queers in Gear Saturday Ride
schedule: Saturdays at 4:00 pm, weather permitting (2026 season announced June 2026)
description: A queer cycling group based in Portland and Lewiston-Auburn, Maine. The Portland ride meets at the Gear Hub, a nonprofit community bike shop, for a 10 to 12 mile social loop. No-drop, all levels, lights required.

name: Gorham Bike & Ski Saco Tuesday Night Gravel Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00 pm, mid-April until the light runs out
description: A moderate-pace mixed-surface ride from the Saco shop: pavement, dirt, and a few singletrack sections thrown in. Gravel bikes suggested, anything welcome. The same shop runs a Wednesday no-drop ride from Clifford Park in Biddeford.

name: Portland Velo Club Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 5:30 pm

start_location.name: South Portland High School parking lot

pace: A 20–26 mph no waiting; B group behind
description: Maine's biggest club's Wednesday hammer ride. The A group leaves at 5:30 and does not wait; if you get dropped, fall in with the B group. Plan on a hard night either way, with a sprint at the end for those who want it.

name: Gorham Bike & Ski Waterville Wednesday Night Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm
description: A no-drop trail ride from the Waterville shop, usually at Quarry Road or Inland Pine Ridge. Twelve to fifteen miles at a moderate pace; if the group splits, it waits. The shop also runs a Thursday 5 pm road ride from the same spot.

name: AAVC Monday Social Road Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm, mid-March through late October
cost: free, club waiver required (non-members arrive 10 min early)
