description: A no-drop, lycra-optional road ride focused on learning safe group riding. About 20 miles, usually out to Dexter and back with a stop. Open to non-members who sign the waiver.

name: Nacho Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, April–October
pace: slow, then fast for the last 15 km, then nachos
description: Out-and-back on one straight road from Homes Brewery. Most of it is chill; the last stretch home gets fast. Ends with nachos. Listed as no-drop style by Wheels in Motion.

name: Cruise: Detroit
schedule: Roughly monthly; dates posted on Instagram and Facebook
description: Queers on bikes. A casual, monthly-ish group ride in and around Detroit, with allies welcome. Routes and meet points change; follow the Instagram for the next one.

name: People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, May 7–Oct 29, 2026; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm sharp
description: A one-hour loop out of Palmer Park through the Apartment District, Golf Club neighborhood, Ferndale, New Center and Boston Edison. Led by a park volunteer. Join for part or all of it.

name: Slow Roll Detroit Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, May through September. Meet 5:00 pm, roll out 6:30 pm, back by 8:30 pm
founded_note: Slow Roll started in Detroit in 2010 and relaunched in 2026 as a smaller Thursday ride, per the RiDetroit page and Momentum Mag (Mar 2026)
description: The ride that started the Slow Roll movement, back on the streets in 2026 after a pause. Now a Thursday ride of 8 to 12 miles at an easy pace, with a set two-hour window. All bikes and all riders. Register once per season and check the Facebook group for the weekly start point.

name: Village Bike & Fitness Tuesday Night Road Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 7:00 pm, weather permitting

start_location.name: Riverside Park boat launch (Monroe & Knapp)
start_location.address: Monroe Ave NE & Knapp St NE, Grand Rapids, MI 49505

description: A shop-led road ride on rolling roads toward Rockford and Cannonsburg and around downtown. It teaches group skills like calling hazards and riding a paceline. Helmets required, lights recommended.

name: Wednesday Evening Rides
schedule: Every Wednesday; meet 7:45 pm, depart 8:00 pm sharp

start_location.name: Veterans Memorial Park
start_location.address: 101 Fulton St E, Grand Rapids, MI 49503

description: A casual 10–12 mile roll through Grand Rapids streets for exploring, socializing and being seen on bikes. Usually ends with a drink at a bar. Bring a working bike, helmet and lights.

name: KBC Monday Night Ride
schedule: Every Monday, March 10–Oct 31; 6:00 pm (5:30 pm in March and October)
pace: up to eight groups, 12–13 mph through 19–21 mph
description: The club's main weeknight ride, with up to eight pace groups from a 12–13 mph no-drop learner ride to a fast Lawton loop. Pick your group in the parking lot. Helmets required.

name: KBC Sunday LGBTQIA+ Allies Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, May–September; arrive 15–20 min early, roll 10:00 am; start rotates by week of month

start_location.name: Rotates: 1st Sun Celery Flats (7328 Garden Ln, Portage); 2nd Sun Texas Drive Park (6603 Texas Dr, Kalamazoo); 3rd Sun Oshtemo Grange Hall (3234 N 3rd St); 4th Sun Kindleberger Park (Parchment)

description: A no-drop club ride for LGBTQIA+ riders and allies. All abilities welcome. Starts rotate between four parks through the month. Helmets required, lights encouraged.

name: Lansing Bike Party
schedule: Every Friday; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm (earlier in fall as days shorten)
founded_note: Started spring 2009 at Beaumont Tower on the MSU campus, per the MSU Bikes blog and East Lansing Info
description: The Lansing area's biggest weekly social ride. A laid-back cruise around the region with a rest stop or two and a stop for food and drinks, then a ride back. Music and bells are common. Bring lights.

name: Quick Stop Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:30 pm
description: A moderate mountain bike ride on mostly blue-square trails with a few black diamonds. Early spring and late fall it turns into a gravel ride, and sometimes a klunker ride. Check the shop or its Facebook page.

name: PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, through mid-September
description: A social, casual ride on paved trails hosted by the PEDAL bike shop. Everyone welcome, all bikes including e-bikes. Party pace, 8 to 12 miles. Last ride of 2026 was September 15.

name: NMMBA Community Group Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:30 pm, May through about the end of October
description: The trail association's own Monday ride on the VASA singletrack. Lots of regroup stops, so nobody rides alone. A good first group ride on dirt.

name: Wildcard Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, early spring to late fall, 6:00 pm rollout

host.name: Wildcard Cycleworks / Universal Racing / Shorts Brewing

description: The Traverse City mountain bike shop ride. Multiple groups by speed, including a slow group for new riders. Snacks and drinks at the trailhead afterward.

name: Ski Hut Wednesday Night Social Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:00 pm (summer)

start_location.name: Location announced weekly by email and social media

description: A beginner-friendly evening ride of about 20 miles put on by the Ski Hut. The start moves around Duluth; the shop posts each week's location. Runs through the summer.

name: Angry Catfish Thursday FTW Social Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm
description: A weekly ride for femme, trans and women riders only. About 15 miles at a talking pace, route varies. Starts and ends at the shop's coffee bar. Ride details go out on the shop's Discord and Instagram.

name: Bonesaw Cycling Collective Summer Tuesday Ride
schedule: Last Tuesday of the month, April–September, meet 6:45 pm, roll 7:00 pm

start_location.name: Cepro Site / Parque Monarca (Midtown Greenway at 10th Ave S)

description: A monthly summer social ride from the Greenway to the Sabo Bridge. 12 to 15 miles at 10–12 mph with a mid-ride stop. Guest groups like Biking with Baddies and the bike polo club help lead. Bring lights and a lock.

name: Fixie Friday
schedule: Fridays, meet 6:45 pm, roll 7:00 pm
description: Fixed gear only. Meets at Behind Bars in Northeast and does a different thing each week: lake laps, river laps, parking-ramp crits, a costume night. Helmet and lights. Each week's route goes up on the shop's Instagram.

name: Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm (spring–September)
description: A weekly road ride out of the Freewheel shop near the U of M. About 25 miles at 15–17 mph. Road or gravel bike, helmet and light. Sign the waiver through the Strava club event; weather cancellations post there too. The 2026 series ends September 16.

name: Joyful Riders Club Monthly Ride at Fulton
schedule: Second Thursday of every month, 6:00 pm
description: A slow, family-friendly party ride that starts and ends at the Fulton taproom in the North Loop. About an hour and a half of riding with music. The club is based in Minneapolis and Saint Paul and also runs summer DJ rides.

name: Joyful Riders DJ Dance Ride at Perennial Cycle
schedule: Monthly Saturday in summer, 7:00 pm (2026 dates included Jun 6 and Sep 12)

host.name: The Joyful Riders Club with Perennial Cycle

description: A DJ on a bike trailer leads a slow ride through Minneapolis with stops for dancing. Part of the Summer DJ Dance Ride Series from Perennial Cycle and the Joyful Riders Club. Party pace, nobody left behind.

name: Sociable Cider x Recovery Bike Shop Wednesday Social Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm (year-round)
description: A slow, meandering loop through Northeast that starts and ends at the cider taproom. Recovery Bike Shop sends mechanical support. Riders get a pint of cider at the finish. Cancellations for weather or holidays get posted on the shop's Instagram.

name: Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides
schedule: Every Sunday, meet 9:45 am, roll 10:00 am
pace: Road groups: Rec 11–13 mph, Sport Ultra Lite 15–17, Sport Lite 17–19, Sport 19–21; three MTB groups on the Wirth trails
description: Sunday morning rides from the brewery next to Theodore Wirth Park. Four road pace groups from 11 mph up, plus three mountain bike groups when the trails are dry. Everyone hangs out on the patio afterward. Helmets required.

name: Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides
schedule: Every Thursday, 5:30 pm gather, 6:00 pm roll (spring and summer)
pace: Road A ~17 mph, Road B ~13 mph, social ~10 mph, MTB at Lone Lake Park
description: Four options leave the brewery at once: two road groups, a mountain bike group at Lone Lake Park, and an 11-mile social ride. All no-drop. Helmets required. Buy-one-get-one beer after.

name: RASC Monday Road Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm (summer)

start_location.name: Bamber Valley Elementary School
start_location.address: Bamber Valley Rd SW, Rochester, MN 55902

cost: membership required; guests may try two rides on a waiver
description: A club road ride split into four speed groups so there is a place for most riders. Meets at Bamber Valley Elementary on the southwest side. There is also a Wednesday road ride from Bicycle Sports and a Thursday gravel ride. Helmets required.

name: Big Shark West Saturday Gravel Growl
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am, year-round

start_location.name: Big Shark West (next to Kaldi's Coffee)

description: A 27-mile gravel loop on the Monarch Levee Trail, the Katy Trail, Busch Greenway and the Hamburg Trail, starting and ending at the west county store. Runs all winter. Gravel, cross, mountain or hybrid bike.

name: KC Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month, meet ~6:30 pm, roll ~7:00 pm

start_location.name: Sunfresh in Westport, back lot off 40th & Pennsylvania

description: A monthly parade-style ride through Kansas City on the last Friday. No set route, no leaders, the slowest rider sets the pace and the group masses up when it spreads out. News and the ride calendar live on the Facebook group.

name: Women-Led Cycling Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Wednesday nights

start_location.name: Waldo, Kansas City, MO (start posted on Instagram)

description: A Wednesday night group ride out of the Waldo neighborhood, led by women and open to everyone. Listed by BikeWalkKC's Women Bike KC program as one of the metro's inclusive ride groups. Meet point and time go up on Instagram each week.

name: Big Shark Saturday Mellow Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am

start_location.name: Big Shark Bicycle Company, Big Bend

pace: chilled out, slightly slower than the shop's main ride
description: The mellow option on Big Shark's Saturday morning road ride from the Big Bend store. 28 miles, no-drop, and the group will shorten the route if it wants. Road bike or quick hybrid. Ride leaders show up when it's above 35 degrees.

name: South Side Cycling Club Wednesday Evening Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm sharp, April 1–October 28
pace: Beginner (up to 10 mi in 1:45), party pace 12–13 mph, intermediate 14–15 mph, advanced 16+ mph

host.name: South Side Cyclery / South Side Cycling Club

description: Four pace groups leave the shop at once, from a true beginner group up to 16+ mph. Routes change weekly around the city and county. Helmets and lights required; arrive early to sign the waiver. Ride changes post on the club's Facebook and Instagram. The shop also runs a fall Saturday 8 am training ride.

name: Spoke Shop Monday Road Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:30 pm
pace: all levels, adjusted to the group
description: Monday evening road ride from the Spoke Shop lot on Broadwater. Billings TrailNet lists it as open to all levels and adjustable to who shows up. The shop also lists a Saturday morning urban ride (12 to 16 miles) and a Wednesday mountain bike ride from Zimmerman Trail, April to early October. Confirm on the shop's Facebook page before you go.

name: Alter Cycles Tuesday Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, during the dry months
founded_note: Already drawing 50+ riders by July 2018, per The Radavist
description: Meet at the shop at 6, carpool to a different trail each week, ride, then grill at the trailhead while the sun goes down. Aimed at the average trail-bike rider; pace is intermediate to advanced. Bring your own food for the BBQ. Weather dependent; the week's trail is posted on the shop's Instagram or you can call the shop that day.

name: Montana Dirt Girls Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, year-round (mountain bikes roughly April–October, hiking the rest of the year)
founded_note: The group has been around since 2001, per its website
description: A women's and female-centered outdoor meetup that mountain bikes on Tuesday evenings from spring into fall and hikes the rest of the year. Location changes each week and goes out by email and on Facebook. Casual and social. Anyone looking for a female-centered space is welcome.

name: Thursday Night Mountain Bike Group
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm; trailhead changes weekly

host.name: Missoula Thursday Night Mountain Bike Group

founded_note: Ride archives on the group's site go back to 2004
description: A long-running informal group that rides a different trail near Missoula every Thursday at 6 pm. New riders are welcome. The week's ride goes out by email list and on the group's Facebook group. Past ride maps on the site show the kind of terrain to expect.

name: Magic Cycles Shop Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:30 pm (mid-March–September)
description: Wednesday shop ride in the High Country, listed on the Boone Area Cyclists ride page with a Strava route. Boone rides go out most weekday evenings at 5:30 from mid-March through September; this is the shop-hosted one.

name: Cycles de ORO Easy Riders Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday evening
description: The shop's ride for new riders and people getting back into it. Tuesday evenings from the store. The shop also runs a conversational-pace social ride every Saturday morning.

name: Cycles de ORO Saturday Social Ride
schedule: Every Saturday morning
description: Saturday morning social ride from the shop at a conversational pace. Start time is on the shop's site and changes with the season.

name: The Hub & Pisgah Tavern Wednesday Shop Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday; time posted in the shop's Strava club
description: No-drop Wednesday mountain bike ride into Pisgah from the shop at the forest entrance, with the tavern waiting after. Weekly time and trail are posted in the Strava club.

name: Great Northern Monday Riding 101 Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm, spring and summer
description: A ride for people who have never ridden in a group on the road. Shop guides teach hand signals, drafting and etiquette at a casual 12–16 mph. Any bike welcome. Distance grows to about 20 miles as the summer goes on. Free parking in the ramp after 5 pm.

name: Great Northern W.O.W. (Women on Wheels) Road Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm, spring and summer
description: A women-only road ride from the downtown shop. 20 to 25 miles at 15–18 mph, no-drop, with the emphasis on spinning and talking. Road bike recommended, helmet required. The shop also runs a Tuesday social ride and a Wednesday fitness ride at 6 pm.

name: Omaha Pedalers Saturday Morning Easy Trail Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am (club signature rides take priority some Saturdays)
description: An easy 20-mile spin on the Keystone Trail from Aksarben, then coffee at Roast Coffee House. The Pedalers are a social club, not a race club, and rides are open to anyone. They also run a Thursday 10 am 'Rusty Spokes' trail ride and a Thursday 5 pm taco ride to Bellevue.

name: The Bike Way / Omaha Velo Monday Shop Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:15 pm
description: The weekly road ride of Omaha's race club, run out of The Bike Way. Fast, 20 mph and up, with regroups; riders are expected to know the route and get themselves home. No TT bikes. There is also a Saturday 9 am no-drop ride from Roast Coffeehouse in Aksarben, May through September.

name: Tuesday Night Women's Gravel Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm
description: A women's gravel ride hosted by Omaha Velo and The Bike Way, leaving from the Papio South trailhead south of Omaha. Same group runs a Saturday 8 am gravel ride from Walnut Creek.

name: Thirsty Turtle
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm, March–October
description: An hour-long Thursday evening ride open to all abilities, then pizza and beer at La Festa. The shop's faster Tuesday Night Ride (19–20 mph, 30–45 miles) leaves from the same door at 5:30.

name: Mama Wheelies Ladies Group Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, meet 5:30 pm, roll 5:45 pm
description: A weekly women's ride that meets at Papa Wheelies on Wednesday evenings and rolls at 5:45. Runs year-round. The group has its own Strava club and Instagram; email mamawheelies@gmail.com with questions.

name: Papa Wheelies Monday Night Road Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm, April–October
description: The Seacoast's Monday night road ride, three pace groups from the shop lot. Drop-bar road bikes only. The A group goes as fast as it wants; the C group at 14–16 is the newer addition for people who want the ride without the racing.

name: Saturday No-Drop Road Ride (Sourland Cycles)
schedule: Saturdays, 9:00 am, spring through fall
description: A shop ride in the Sourland hills north of Princeton. Starts the season as a flat 15-mile beginner ride and grows from there as the leader sees fit. No drop. Helmet and lights required. The shop also runs no-drop weekday co-ed rides Mondays at 4 and Thursdays at 10.

name: Women's Wednesday Road Ride (Sourland Cycles)
schedule: Wednesday evenings, start between 5:00 and 6:00 pm, spring through fall
description: A friendly no-drop road ride for women, about 24 miles with 1,200 feet of climbing in the Sourlands. Beginners and seasoned riders both welcome. The shop also runs a women's no-drop mountain bike ride on the third Thursday of summer months.

name: Bike JC Light-Up Ride
schedule: Monthly, a Friday at 7:30 pm

start_location.name: Grove Street PATH plaza
start_location.address: Grove St & Newark Ave, Jersey City, NJ 07302

description: A monthly evening group ride from the Grove Street PATH plaza, run by Jersey City's bike advocacy group. Lights on, easy pace, all kinds of bikes. The next date is posted on bikejc.org and Instagram.

name: Friday Ladies Ride (Montclair Bikery)
schedule: Fridays, 9:00 am, April–October
pace: C pace, low to mid teens mph
description: A weekday-morning women's road ride from the shop, strictly C pace: 20 to 35 miles in the low to mid teens. Shop staff ride along. Call the shop for the WhatsApp link. Helmets required; wet roads cancel.

name: Saturday Shop Ride (Montclair Bikery)
schedule: Saturdays, 8:00 am, April–October
pace: A or B pace depending on who shows
description: A weekend road ride from the shop, A or B pace depending on the group. Routes are posted in the shop's WhatsApp chat; call the shop to get the link. Self-supported: bring your own flat kit, food and water. Helmets required. Cancelled for wet roads or freezing temps.

name: JSTS Weeknight Rides (Jersey Shore Touring Society)
schedule: Tuesday and Wednesday evenings, roughly 4:45–5:30 pm as sunset shifts; weekend morning rides too
founded_note: Club site mentions a 40th anniversary but does not state the founding year
cost: membership required for outdoor rides; free trial membership available
description: A Monmouth County club that says its focus is social, not competitive. The September calendar shows Tuesday and Wednesday evening rides of 18 to 27 miles in several pace groups, plus long weekend rides. Outdoor rides are members-only with advance sign-up; a free trial membership gets you in the door.

name: NMTS Saturday Easy Group Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: Open Space Shining River parking lot

description: A short, easy Saturday ride at around 13 mph, about 15 miles. The gentlest ride on the club's weekly list and a reasonable first group ride in Albuquerque. Helmet required.

name: NMTS Sunday Bosque Trail Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: Open Space Shining River parking area

description: A Sunday morning road ride along the Rio Grande bosque trail from Albuquerque's touring club. About 36 miles and open to all paces. Approved helmet required. The club posts a full weekly ride list on its site.

name: Bike & Chowder Club Rides
schedule: Sundays, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays; see the club schedule
founded_note: Founded 1984, per the club's website
description: A Las Cruces recreational riding group going since 1984. No memberships, no dues, one rule: helmets. Most rides end with coffee or food. Four rides a week; times and start points are on the club's schedule page.

name: Santa Fe Road Riders Weekend Rides
schedule: Saturdays gravel, Sundays road; start rotates on a monthly pattern (in-town weeks start at Betterday Coffee)
description: A volunteer-run weekend ride group: gravel on Saturdays, road on Sundays. Starts rotate through the month between in-town coffee shops, Pojoaque and south of town. No guaranteed leader or sweep. Details and weather calls go out in a private Facebook group.

name: Santa Fe Seniors on Bikes Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday; start time shifts by month (9:00 am in summer, 11:00 am in winter)

start_location.name: DeVargas Mall
start_location.address: 564 N Guadalupe St, Santa Fe, NM 87501

description: A social road ride for riders 50 and older, split into an energetic A group and a relaxed B group. Rides cancel automatically in freezing, hot, wet or windy weather. The club also rides Thursdays (April–October) and Saturdays.

name: Giant Las Vegas Summerlin Saturday Road Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am (Sunday 7:00 am faster ride; Mountain's Edge store Saturday 6:30 am)

start_location.name: Giant Las Vegas – Summerlin
start_location.address: 2283 N Rampart Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89128

description: A relaxed 25-mile Saturday shop ride at 13 to 16 mph with regroups; the shop says no one is ever left behind. The Sunday ride from the same store is the fast one at 18 to 20 mph, and the Mountain's Edge store runs a 40 to 50 mile Saturday ride.

name: Giant Las Vegas Tuesday Night MTB Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 7:00 pm
pace: two groups: faster 12–15 mi and casual 8–12 mi
description: Night mountain bike ride on the Cottonwood Valley trails out of Blue Diamond. Two groups, both no-drop, about two hours. Bring lights. Call the shop (702-844-2453, option 1) with questions.

name: Pedal & Pour Sunday Coffee Ride
schedule: Every Sunday morning (Friday Loop Ride, 41 mi, for faster riders); RSVP on the shop's Strava club

start_location.name: Pedal & Pour
start_location.address: 9742 W Maule Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89148

description: A coffee shop and bike shop in one. The Sunday Coffee Ride is a relaxed 20-mile loop from the shop that ends back at the cafe. Friday's Loop Ride is 41 miles for more experienced riders. RSVP through the shop's Strava club.

name: Bike Night Reno
schedule: Every Wednesday, show up 7:45 pm, roll about 8:15 pm

start_location.name: Reno City Plaza (Believe sign / Space Whale)

description: A weekly downtown social night ride that meets at the Believe sign in City Plaza. Everyone is welcome, any bike. Routes are on the group's Strava club. Listed on the Reno Wheelmen calendar.

name: Reno Wheelmen Wednesday Group Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:30 pm (seasonal; waiver required once per season)
pace: B ~18 mph, C ~15 mph, faster riders self-organize
description: The club's Wednesday evening ride out to Verdi with B and C groups behind ride leaders. Groups ride out together in a double paceline at talking pace and regroup three times, but don't necessarily wait on the way back. The club notes the slower groups are not slow.

name: Sparks Group Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 10:00 am (start time may shift in summer heat)
pace: friendly, social, recreational; all experience levels
description: A friendly, social Saturday ride from a Sparks bike shop, open to all experience levels. Moved to Sierra Bicycle Supply in June 2026 so riders can grab supplies before rolling. Listed on the Reno Wheelmen calendar with weekly ride updates.

name: Slow Roll Buffalo Monday Night Community Ride
schedule: Every Monday, mid-May through mid-October. Meet 6:00 pm, ride 6:30 pm (5:30 pm in October)
founded_note: Launched 2014, per the About Us page
description: A ten-mile guided ride from a different host neighborhood every Monday, with two regroup stops and an after-party with food and music. A volunteer SQUAD of over 100 keeps the ride together. Kids, seniors and first-timers ride. 2026 season runs May 18 to October 12.

name: Slow Spokes Tuesday Ride at Wilkeson Pointe
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm
description: A relaxed Tuesday evening ride from the Outer Harbor. Slow Spokes runs a free ride somewhere in Western New York almost every weeknight; this is the Buffalo one. All skill levels, ends back at the bar.

name: OCC Tuesday Slow N' Easy Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday in summer, 6:00 pm
founded_note: Club site: cycling in Central NY since 1972
description: A beginner ride on flat, low-traffic roads west of Syracuse. Two experienced riders lead every group and nobody gets left behind. Any bike works; families with kids are welcome. A faster option leaves from the same park the same night.

name: Slow Spokes Friday Ride in Lockport
schedule: Every Friday, 6:00 pm
description: Friday evening slow ride along the canal town of Lockport. Same format as the other Slow Spokes nights: easy pace, all bikes, a stop or two, back to the cafe.

name: New York Cycle Club Weekend Rides
schedule: Every Saturday and Sunday, plus select weekdays; start times vary by ride
pace: A 19–22 mph / B 15–18 mph / C 12–14 mph
founded_note: Instagram bio: founded in 1936
description: The city's largest recreational club runs member-led rides every weekend to Westchester, Connecticut, Long Island and across the Hudson. Three levels. C rides and most B rides are no-drop; A rides are not. Helmets required, no exceptions.

name: NYC Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month, 7:00 pm

start_location.name: Union Square North
start_location.address: Union Square N, New York, NY 10003

founded_note: Started in NYC in the 1990s per TIME'S UP!'s site
description: The monthly mass ride that helped change how the city treats cyclists. Meets at Union Square North on the last Friday of the month at 7 pm. No leader, no set route; the group decides where it goes.

name: OutCycling Weekly Park Laps
schedule: Weekly lap sessions in Central Park and Prospect Park, spring through fall; dates and times posted in the club's Spond group
description: New York's largest LGBTQ+ cycling club runs weekly park laps for building fitness plus over 150 rides a year, with a lead and a sweep on hosted rides. Two tiers, recreational and advanced. Rides require sign-up in Spond, so join first.

name: Thursday Night Social Bikeride
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:00 pm (April through December)

start_location.name: Columbus Circle entrance of Central Park

founded_note: TIME'S UP! itself has run for 35 years per its site; ride start year not given
description: A weekly social ride that meets at the Columbus Circle entrance to Central Park every Thursday at 7. Run by Time's Up!, the volunteer environmental group that also hosts a fix-your-own-bike workshop and the Wednesday night skate.

name: Just for Giggles Monday Night Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:15 pm (plus Saturday 8:00 am from Schoen Place, Pittsford)
founded_note: Facebook group says established 2012
description: An informal Rochester group that rides for fun and usually ends at a brewery. Monday evenings roll from Three Heads Brewing; Saturday mornings from Schoen Place in Pittsford. Over 3,000 members in the Facebook group, where each ride is posted.

name: Rochester Bike Gang Thursday Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:30 pm
founded_note: Facebook group created August 2021
description: A casual Thursday night ride from Parcel 5 downtown. All bikes, all riders, no skill requirement. Routes and details go up in the Facebook group each week.

name: MHCC Tuesday Evening River Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:30 pm
cost: free, club membership encouraged ($20/yr; one free trial ride for non-members)
description: A Tuesday evening club ride along the Mohawk from Kiwanis Park, west of Schenectady. Tour pace, member-led. The Capital Region club posts its public ride schedule online; non-members get one free ride before joining.

name: Danny's Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride
schedule: Every Sunday in summer, meet 9:00 am, roll 9:30 am
description: A no-drop Sunday morning shop ride out of Scarsdale, open to anyone, not just customers. Fair-weather only. The shop also runs Saturday gravel/road rides and an MTB ride from Mohegan Lake.

name: WCC USI Monday Night Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm
founded_note: Club site: riding together since 1975
cost: free with club membership ($20/household per year)
description: A B-pace Monday evening ride from the Waller Avenue lot in White Plains, with a shorter and a longer option. Westchester Cycle Club also runs faster Tuesday and Thursday training rides from the same lot at 5:15 pm.

name: Athens Bicycle Club Sunday Lake Hope MTB Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, year-round; meet 9:45 am at Lake Hope (carpool from Beacon School, Athens, at 9:00 am)

start_location.name: Lake Hope State Park, Four Points area
start_location.address: Lake Hope State Park, McArthur, OH 45651

description: A weekly trail ride at Lake Hope State Park. Route and distance get set by the skills of whoever shows up. A club member leads every ride. Helmets required.

name: BioWheels Monday Night Tour de Indian Hill
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm
pace: B group 17–19 mph, C group 14–16 mph
description: A shop ride into Indian Hill with two hills and regroups at the top. Two speed groups led by volunteers. Route changes weekly.

name: Ride Pleasant Streets
schedule: 1st and 3rd Saturdays; gather 1:45 pm, roll 2:05 pm (3:00 pm in winter months)
description: Neighborhood rides out of Pleasant Ridge with a safety talk first. First Saturdays are short, third Saturdays longer. Routes favor low-stress streets and paths and are shared a few days ahead.

name: UBBC Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:15 pm
description: A casual ride through city streets and alleys on both sides of the river, then back to a bar for a post-ride drink. No one gets dropped. Red Bike station at 14th and Elm if you need wheels.

name: Cycle Canalway Sunday Social Ride
schedule: Third Sunday of the month, June–September, 10:00 am
description: Free guided rides from Canal Basin Park along the Lake Link Trail to Edgewater Park and back. Ride support from the Ohio City Bicycle Co-op. Helmets required.

name: Slow Roll Cleveland
schedule: Most Mondays, May 4–Oct 26, 2026; gather 6:00 pm, roll 7:00 pm; different neighborhood each week
founded_note: 2026 is billed as the 13th season on the club's site
description: About ten miles at an easy pace through a different Cleveland neighborhood every Monday. Hundreds of riders of all backgrounds and abilities. Check the schedule for that week's meeting spot.

name: Cafe Hero Sunday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday morning, April–October; 2nd Sunday of the month is the no-drop pace-group ride
pace: A/B/C pace groups on 2nd Sundays; looser 'decaffeinated' rides other weeks
description: Coffee and a group ride out of Hoof Hearted in Italian Village, with discounted Royal Flamingo coffee before and after. Second Sunday each month has A, B and C groups and is no-drop for everyone. Times and routes are posted on the Strava club.

name: Columbus Friday Night Ride
schedule: Every Friday; meet 6:30 pm, roll 7:00 pm
description: A chill Friday social ride from Topiary Park with a playlist. Route and destination get decided by whoever shows up. Bring lights.

name: Thursday Night Central Columbus & Metro Parks Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:30 pm

start_location.name: Nocterra Brewing bike racks, Scioto Audubon Metro Park

cost: free; one-time season registration, membership or $20 donation suggested
description: A relaxed, no-drop ride on Central Ohio's trail network with little road riding. Meant for newer and returning riders. Mid-ride refreshment stops are common and everyone is back before dark.

name: Wheels of Color Thursday Night Ride Therapy
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:15 pm, May 1–Oct 2
pace: Pace A through D groups (about 10 to 16+ mph)
description: A Thursday ride run by Wheels of Color, a Columbus cycling crew that rides alongside Major Taylor and Black Girls Do Bike groups. Road and trail options with multiple paces; road loops run 15 to 35 miles.

name: Thursday Bishop's Casual Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:15 pm
founded_note: Club established 1880, per BioWheels' club listing
description: An easy club ride on the Little Miami Bike Trail and roads around Milford. Fifteen or twenty miles at the pace of the slowest rider. No one left behind.

name: ABC Monday Evening Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm, in season

start_location.name: Brust Park
start_location.address: 128 N Main St, Munroe Falls, OH 44262

founded_note: Club formed 1965, per its Come Ride With Us page
cost: free for members and first-time guests
description: A social ride at a comfortable pace for beginning and casual riders, mixing road and paved trail. Routes vary weekly. Regroups often and no one is left behind. Helmets required.

name: DCC Kesling Park Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Kesling Park, front lot by the basketball court
start_location.address: 7201 Red Lion 5 Points Rd, Springboro, OH 45066

pace: groups from 12–15 mph up to 19+ mph
founded_note: Club founded 1961, per its homepage
description: The Dayton club's Thursday road ride south of town. Several pace groups from 12–15 mph up to 19+, all no-drop. Lights required as evenings shorten.

name: TAB Windsday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday; 6:30 pm May–August, 6:00 pm in September
pace: road B (19–21 mph); gravel C/D (16–20 mph)
description: The Toledo club's midweek ride with both a road group and a gravel group. Routes change and get posted on the club's Facebook page. Helmets required, no earbuds.

name: Edmond Tuesday Casual Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:16 pm (April–September)

start_location.name: Edmond City Hall
start_location.address: Littler Ave & Main St, Edmond, OK 73034

description: A short, slow no-drop ride from Edmond City Hall. Eight to 10 miles at 8 to 10 mph. Built for people who are new to riding in a group. Summer season only.

name: Monday Nights at Arcadia Trails
schedule: Every Monday, 6:45 pm

start_location.name: Post Road parking lot, under the Edmond water tower (northeast side of Arcadia Lake)

pace: not too fast, regroups at water stops
description: A Monday night mountain bike ride on the Arcadia Lake trails. All levels welcome, regroups at the water stops, and the group splits in two if needed. Helmets required, lights recommended.

name: Phat Tire Edmond Tuesday Night Road Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:10 pm

start_location.name: Phat Tire Bike Shop Edmond, Spring Creek Shopping Center

description: Tuesday road ride from the Edmond shop. Routes run 26 to 34 miles at about 17 mph with several regroups, and the shop says nobody gets left behind. Updates go out on the Ride Alert app.

name: Lazy Circles Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:30 pm (March–November)

host.name: Bicycle League of Norman with Phat Tire Norman and local shops

cost: free; first beer on the house
description: Norman's entry-level weeknight ride. Three groups leave the brewery at 11, 14 and 16 mph and are back in about an hour. Supported by the Bicycle League of Norman, Phat Tire, Scissortail Cycles and Buchanan Bicycles. Does not run in rain.

name: Lake to Lake Friday Ride
schedule: Every Friday, 6:30 pm

start_location.name: Phat Tire Bike Shop, Oklahoma City (May Avenue)

description: A Friday evening loop from the May Avenue shop out to Lake Hefner and Lake Overholser and back, about 30 miles at around 17.5 mph. Billed as no-drop. Weather dependent.

name: OBS Donut Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:04 am

start_location.name: Will Rogers Park Tennis Center, east end of parking lot
start_location.address: 400 N Portland Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73107

pace: entry level, set by the slowest rider
description: About 12 miles round trip to a donut shop and back. The pace is set by the slowest rider, and nobody gets dropped. Runs every Saturday of the year, weather permitting. A good first group ride in OKC.

name: Saturday Morning Nomad Leisurely Ride
schedule: Every Saturday morning; start location and time posted on the club calendar
description: A slow Saturday ride that moves around Tulsa each week, hence the name. Ten to 12 mph, nobody left behind. The club also runs a faster Saturday club ride that is not no-drop.

name: Tuesday Evening Leisurely Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday evening; start time shifts with the season, see club calendar

start_location.name: River Parks parking lot, 68th & Riverside (overflow at Tom's Bicycles)

description: The club's easy weeknight ride along the river. Three pace groups from 8 to 18 mph, all no-drop and social, with regroup stops. Helmets required; lights required in fall and winter.

name: Ashland Cycle Sport Wednesday Night MTB Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:30 pm
pace: moderate to hard, with steep climbs and descents
description: A Wednesday evening shop mountain bike ride on the Ashland trails. Routes run an hour to an hour and a half and include real climbing. Helmets and a working bike are required; lights from October through March.

name: The Handlebar Tuesday Shop Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:30 pm
description: A Tuesday mountain bike ride led by shop staff. Starts and ends at the shop and rides up and down the Ashland trail system. Pitched at intermediate riders. Bring your own bike, tools, food and lights.

name: Tuesday Night Rubber Mallet
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:30 pm

start_location.name: Jackson's Outpost at The Grove
start_location.address: 921 NW Mt Washington Dr Ste 170, Bend, OR 97703

description: A spirited Tuesday road ride that rotates three routes. Not a no-drop ride, but the group regroups two or three times and teaches cooperative riding instead of a free-for-all. Riders should be self-sufficient. It is not affiliated with WebCyclery even though it used to start there.

name: MVBC Tenners Saturday Social Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am (Jun–Sep) or 10:00 am (Oct–May)
founded_note: MVBC site says the club was founded in 1974 (club founding, not this ride)
description: The club's Saturday social ride on paved roads around Corvallis. Around 12 to 15 mph with regroups so nobody is left behind. Newcomers are welcome. The club also runs a faster Saturday group and Wednesday road and gravel rides from the same spot.

name: GEARs WTNB Wednesday Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm
founded_note: GEARs site says 'Riding since 1992' (club founding, not this ride)
description: A short evening ride for women, trans and non-binary riders, listed on the GEARs September schedule. About 10 miles at 10–12 mph from Alton Baker Park. GEARs asks riders to sign up online before the ride.

name: Klink Cycles Social Ride
schedule: First and third Wednesday of the month
description: A shop social ride on the first and third Wednesday, rain or shine. All ages, bodies and abilities welcome. Details for each ride go out on the shop's Instagram.

name: Keizer Family Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:30 pm
description: A Thursday evening family ride from Cummings Elementary in Keizer, north of Salem. Listed on the Salem Bicycle Club calendar every Thursday through early October. Registration on the club site is encouraged but not required.

name: Gay Gravel Group
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 5:00 pm, roll 5:30 pm

start_location.name: Cycle Town Coffee Roasters
start_location.address: NW 16th Ave and NW Thurman St, Portland, OR 97209

description: A queer-led Wednesday gravel ride up into Forest Park, open to everyone. Meets at Cycle Town Coffee in Northwest and climbs about a thousand feet on the fire lanes. Listed weekly on the Shift calendar.

name: Ride Safe PDX Thursdays
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:30 pm

start_location.name: Colonel Summers Park
start_location.address: SE 20th Ave & SE Belmont St, Portland, OR 97214

description: A weekly queer-led social ride. Theme, route and playlist change each week. Every ride has a store stop, leaders who help with mechanicals, and a code of conduct. First Thursday of the month is a masked ride.

name: Sorella Forte Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am

start_location.name: River City Bicycles parking lot
start_location.address: 706 SE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Portland, OR 97214

pace: no-drop, roughly 11–16 mph; the shop lists 14–19 mph
description: A weekly road ride for women, trans and non-binary cyclists. Rolls out of the River City Bicycles lot and is usually back by noon. Nobody gets left behind; the group fixes flats and regroups at major points.

name: Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:00 pm
founded_note: Rolling out from Salmon Street Springs every Thursday since 2015, per the Shift calendar listing
description: Portland's longest-running weekly social ride. Routes and leaders change each week; expect a party-paced loop with the regulars of the so-called rolling dive bar. Listed every week on the Shift calendar.

name: CAT Women's Ride
schedule: Weekly, Tuesday or Wednesday evening at 6:00 pm; sign up on Meetup for the exact day

start_location.name: Charlie Brown Ice House, Sand Island

description: An easy women's ride on streets and trails toward Easton or Allentown, from the Ice House on Sand Island. Nobody gets left behind and the group often stops for a drink after. CAT also runs weekend social rides from its co-op on Walnut Street and weekday-morning coffee rides.

name: Slow Roll Erie
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm, weather dependent

start_location.name: West Perry Square, by the artistic bike rack

description: A free, noncompetitive ride around downtown Erie for all skill levels. Different route each week, about an hour, then hanging out in the square. Rides on open streets, so not for young kids.

name: Girls Gone Cycle Monday Ride
schedule: Every Monday, April–August; meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Walnut Creek Middle School parking lot

description: Women-only rides west of Erie for everyone from racers to people who just bought a bike. Twelve to thirty miles depending on your level. Helmets mandatory.

name: Tuesday Training Ride (Lancaster Bicycle Club)
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00 pm
pace: A (18–20 mph) and A+ (20–22 mph) groups
cost: $21/yr club membership (currently waived); Meetup RSVP required
description: A show-and-go 25-mile training loop with no designated leader. Fast pacelining; riders who can't hold the pace may be dropped. E-bikes not recommended. The club runs slower no-drop rides on the same evenings; the full schedule lives on Meetup.

name: UA Friendship Park Evening Rides (Harrisburg Bicycle Club)
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 6:00 pm (B+ group sometimes rolls 5:40 pm as days shorten)
description: Twice-weekly club rides from Friendship Park in Upper Allen, split into B+, B and C groups so most road riders find a fit. The club calendar also lists Hershey evening rides Mondays and Thursdays and a Mechanicsburg Saturday C ride at 9 am.

name: Après Gravel (Philly Gravel Club)
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm
description: A fixed gravel loop through the Wissahickon every Monday evening. Beginner friendly and a little goofy on purpose. No drop. The club also runs a Sunday Funday gravel ride on alternate Sundays for intermediate riders.

name: Gravel Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe)
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm, April–October
pace: social, no-drop, regroup at the top of each climb
description: Seventeen miles, about 65 percent gravel, through the Wissahickon. Two notorious climbs but the group waits at the top of each. Espresso shots at the finish. Bring charged lights. Bike demos available for $30; parking and bag storage at the shop.

name: Laurel Hill Fridays
schedule: Fridays, 6:45 am
description: A women-led, WTF-friendly early-morning social ride in Philadelphia. Listed on the Trellis Philly community calendar. Details and the week's meeting point are on Instagram.

name: RAR Philadelphia Group Rides
schedule: Regular weekend rides posted on Instagram, including a five-ride More Miles Series and social spins along the Schuylkill River Trail
description: The Philadelphia chapter of Radical Adventure Riders centers FTWN-B and BIPOC riders. Rides in 2026 have included gravel on Forbidden Drive, a donut loop on MLK Drive and a More Miles series for going longer. No fixed weekly slot; follow Instagram or the Strava club.

name: Sunny Sunday D Ride (Bicycle Club of Philadelphia)
schedule: Sundays, 12:00 pm

start_location.name: Azalea Garden formal entrance, behind the Art Museum

description: A casual club ride through Fairmount Park and beyond for people new to group riding or coming back to it. Regroups as needed. Some weeks are flagged instructional and cover basics like shifting and clipless pedals. Helmet and water required; bad weather cancels.

name: Wednesday Night Rides
schedule: Every other Wednesday, 7:00 pm; start park changes each ride
pace: easy to adventurous, depending on the ride
description: A biweekly themed social ride that ends somewhere: a brewery, a park, a taco spot. Starts move around (Marconi Plaza, Palmer Park, Logan Square). Flat and hilly options. Its sister ride, Northwest Night Rides, runs the alternate Wednesdays in the northwest.

name: Major Taylor Cycling PGH Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday evening; rain cancels
description: A weekly no-drop tour around the city from OTB on the South Side, twelve to eighteen miles at a casual pace. Run by the local Major Taylor club, whose membership is open to all.

name: Pgh Babes on Bikes Frigid Witch Training Rides
schedule: First six Sundays of the year; meet 12:30 pm, B groups roll 1:00, C 1:15, A 1:30
pace: A/B/C pace groups; C group stays together, A and B are drop rides
description: Winter training rides for women and underrepresented genders ahead of the Frigid Witch ride on Valentine's Day. Pace groups exist because volunteers lead them. Snacks, coffee and merch at the brewery.

name: Team Decaf Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, April until the first Tuesday in October

start_location.name: Highland Park entrance (welcome sculptures), top of N Highland Ave at Reservoir Dr
start_location.address: N Highland Ave & Reservoir Dr, Pittsburgh, PA 15206

description: City road rides out of Highland Park, splitting into slower and faster groups. Around thirty riders a week. Lights recommended early and late in the season.

name: State College Cycling Club Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday; 5:30 pm April and September, 6:00 pm May–August; start rotates by week (Circleville Park, Fairbrook Park, Mount Nittany Middle School, Bernel Road Park)
pace: A through C speed groups (12 to 20+ mph)
description: Road rides for a range of abilities with speed groups from C (12–14 mph) up to A. Start location changes by week of the month. New riders are told to pick an easier group than they think.

name: Dash Bicycle First Sunday Ride
schedule: First Sunday of the month, 10:00 am, weather permitting
founded_note: Shop page says it reintroduced group rides in summer 2021
description: A free-form monthly road ride into the rural roads outside Providence, adjusted to how the group feels. Helmets mandatory, lycra not. The shop's Wednesday 7 am no-drop recovery ride is paused until spring; check Instagram for updates.

name: Providence Bike Jam
schedule: Once a month on a Friday night; details posted on Instagram the day before

start_location.name: Varies (Burnside Park and India Point Park are common)

founded_note: Grew out of the Critical Mass movement, per Dash Bicycle's ride page
description: A monthly Friday night bike party. Themed rides, dance-party stops, a pace around 10 mph. The start location changes; it's posted on Instagram at least a day ahead.

name: Awendaw Friday Social (Beginner) Ride
schedule: Every Friday, 10:00 am
description: The beginner-labeled version of the club's Awendaw ride. Thirty-two miles on quiet roads north of Charleston at 15 to 17 mph, no-drop. The A and B groups leave from the same spot at 9 if you want faster.

name: Daniel Island Sunday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 10:00 am (2:00 pm in winter)
description: No-drop Sunday ride with three distance options so you can bail early. Fourteen to sixteen miles an hour. Moves to 2 pm in the winter months.

name: Greenville Spinners SCTAC Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00–8:30 pm

start_location.name: Greenville Spinners parking lot at SCTAC

description: The Spinners' weekly Tuesday evening ride on the closed perimeter roads of the old Donaldson air base. A 500-plus member club, so expect several groups. Details on pace and distance are on the club site.

name: Social Fun Sunday
schedule: Every Sunday, 10:00 am
description: The Charleston club's easy Sunday ride. Twenty-two flat miles around Sullivan's Island and Mount Pleasant at 14 to 18 mph, no-drop. All Coastal Cyclists rides are open to non-members who want to try the club.

name: Major Taylor Thirsty Thursday
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm (late March–late September)

start_location.name: Trek Bicycle Germantown (parking lot north of the tennis courts)

description: Thursday evening no-drop ride in Germantown, run under the Hightailers' Major Taylor banner. Twenty to twenty-eight miles in B, C and D groups. Seasonal, spring through September.

name: Coffee Outside
schedule: Monthly, a Sunday, 9:00–11:30 am
description: A short, slow ride to the Gay Street Bridge to make coffee outside. Bring a stove and a mug if you have them; the shop brings extras if you don't. Once a month on a Sunday morning.

name: Two Bikes Bike Party
schedule: Monthly, typically the last Friday, 6:00–8:00 pm
description: Themed monthly social ride from Knoxville's nonprofit bike shop. Four to eight miles at party pace, usually ending at a brewery or some other destination rather than back at the shop. Helmets required, locks recommended.

name: The Chill Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 2:00 pm; start point rotates

start_location.name: Rotates: Overton Park, Big River Crossing, Shelby Farms, Crosstown Brewery and others

description: The Hightailers' slowest club ride. Ten to twenty miles, capped at 16 mph, no-drop. Start location changes week to week and is posted in the Facebook group. Helmets required on all club rides.

name: Hightailers Tuesday Gravel
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Loven-Fresh BBQ
start_location.address: Lakewood Dr and Hwy 64, Oakland, TN 38060

description: Weeknight gravel ride on the farm roads east of Memphis. Twenty-five to forty miles, no-drop, gravel bikes. Starts from a barbecue joint in Oakland. The same leader runs a longer Saturday gravel ride that moves around north Mississippi.

name: Austin Ridge Riders Sunday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday morning; trail rotates, see Meetup
description: The Austin Ridge Riders mountain bike club runs a no-drop Sunday morning ride with dedicated ride leaders. Trails rotate around the Austin area. Details for each week are posted on the club's Meetup page.

name: Scout-a-Route Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 9:00 am
description: The slower of Mellow Johnny's Saturday shop rides. It rolls from the downtown shop at a 12 to 16 mph pace and explores a different route each week. The shop bills its rides as no-drop, no-ego. Check the shop's ride calendar before you go.

name: Thursday Night Social Ride
schedule: Every Thursday. Meet around 7:30 pm
description: Austin's big weekly cruise, with 150 to 350 riders most Thursdays. Easy pace, rotating ride leader, and a stop or two along the way. Meets at Chicano Park on the east side. Ride details post to Instagram each week.

name: BVMBA Tuesday Social Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 6:15 pm, roll 6:30 pm

start_location.name: Lake Bryan boat ramp parking lot

description: The Bryan–College Station mountain bike club's weekly no-drop trail ride at Lake Bryan. Meet and greet at 6:15, roll at 6:30. All skill levels. Check the BVMBA calendar for changes.

name: Midweek Motley (Southenders)
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:30 am

start_location.name: 1862 Rock Prairie / Pebble Creek entrance (two starts)
start_location.address: Rock Prairie Rd, College Station, TX 77845

description: A weekday morning road ride from the south side of College Station, listed by Brazos Valley Cyclists. Two start points, Rock Prairie and the Pebble Creek entrance. The same group runs Friday Follies and a Saturday ride at the same hour.

name: Bicycle World Tuesday No-Drop Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, wheels down 6:30 pm

start_location.name: Bicycle World Corpus Christi (shop parking lot)

description: A Tuesday evening no-drop ride from the Corpus Christi shop lot. Bring a working bike, water and a helmet. Rides are weather dependent, so confirm with the shop.

name: Saturday Light Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 pm

start_location.name: Parking lot across from Residence Inn on Shoreline

cost: free with your own bike; lit rental bikes available
description: A Saturday night lights ride down Ocean Drive, through the Water Gardens and up Chaparral. Anything that rolls is welcome, including scooters and one-wheels. Run by the local LED light maker CC LED with the Hype Bike and Bicycle World crowds. Family friendly.

name: Dallas Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of every month. Meet 7:30 pm, roll 8:00 pm
description: A monthly social ride of 10-plus miles from the Dallas Farmers Market at an easy 10 to 12 mph. Bring lights, a helmet and water. Riders handle their own repairs.

name: Denton Women Cyclists Tuesday Social Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, gather 6:45 pm, roll 7:00 pm
description: A no-drop ride for women, femme and non-binary riders. Eight to 12 miles at an easy 8 to 10 mph. Cancellations go up on the group's Facebook page.

name: East Side Social Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:30 pm
description: Denton's biggest Thursday ride. Meets at East Side bar off the square, rolls about 12 to 15 miles at 11 to 14 mph, and ends back at the bar. No-drop.

name: Monday Community Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm (March–November)
description: A no-drop social ride from the north side of the courthouse lawn. About 12 miles in an hour at 10 to 12 mph. Cancelled when it is over 100 degrees. Good first group ride.

name: El Paso Bicycle Club Saturday Road Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:00 am (start time shifts with the season)
pace: A group 14–16 mph, B group faster
description: The club's main weekend ride. Around 30 miles with an A group at 14 to 16 mph and a faster B group. Helmets mandatory, non-members welcome. Times change through the year to chase daylight.

name: Thursday Morning Cruise
schedule: Every Thursday, 7:00 am (start time shifts with the season)

start_location.name: Starbucks at the Outlet Shoppes
start_location.address: 7051 S Desert Blvd, El Paso, TX 79932

description: A no-drop weekday ride on the upper valley roads. About 25 to 30 miles at 14 to 16 mph. Non-members are welcome. Departure time moves with daylight, so check Meetup, and arrive 15 minutes early to sign in.

name: FWBA Saturday Club Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:00 am; start location rotates around the Fort Worth area
founded_note: Established in 1970, per the FWBA About page
description: One of the oldest clubs in North Texas. FWBA posts a Saturday ride every week, and Sundays most weeks, with the start rotating across Tarrant and nearby counties. Multiple distances and paces on each ride. Check the home page ride calendar for this week's start.

name: The Thursday Ride – Trek Fort Worth South
schedule: Every Thursday, wheels down 6:15 pm
description: A weeknight shop ride from the Trek store on Granbury Road. About 18 miles at 14 to 16 mph. It is a drop ride, so you need to hold that pace. Helmets and daytime lights required. Cancellations are posted on the shop's Facebook by noon Wednesday.

name: Blue Line Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday evening; call the shop for roll-out time
description: A midweek road ride from the Heights shop. About 20 miles at 17 to 20 mph. Helmets and lights are mandatory. The ride needs an experienced leader and gets cancelled when one is not available, so confirm with the shop first.

name: Critical Mass Houston
schedule: Last Friday of every month. Gather 6:45–7:15 pm, roll 7:15 pm
description: A casual monthly ride from Guadalupe Plaza Park east of downtown, going wherever, ending somewhere fun around 9:30 or 10. Rain or shine. Bring lights and a helmet.

name: Tuesgay Social Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, meet 7:00 pm, roll 7:30 pm
founded_note: Started 2018 by David Loredo as a Pride bike parade, per the group's About page and OutSmart Magazine
description: An LGBTQ+ social ride open to everyone, allies included. Social hour at Varsity Bar at 7, roll out at 7:30, a different bar or restaurant as the midpoint each week. Social pace, 13 mph max, 20 miles tops. No spandex required.

name: Mujeres Mondays
schedule: Every Monday, 6:30 pm

host.name: Bicycle World RGV with Corazón Racing

description: A women-only Monday evening ride from the McAllen shop, run with the Corazón Racing women's team. Details each week go up on Corazón Racing's Facebook. Helmet and a working bike required.

name: TNT Ride (Tuesday & Thursday)
schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 6:30 pm
description: Twice-weekly evening road ride from the McAllen shop with a 22-mile and a 33-mile option. Saturday morning rides of 22 to 60 miles also leave from the same lot. Weather dependent; confirm with the shop.

name: SATX Social Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 7:00 pm
founded_note: Started 2013 with six riders, per the group's Awesome Foundation project page
description: A big Tuesday night social ride through San Antonio. It grew from six riders to close to 300 a week, with about 30 volunteer marshals handling mechanicals and traffic. No-drop and follows the rules of the road so new riders are not stressed.

name: Cameron Park Sunday MTB Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 2:00 pm
description: A no-drop trail ride on Cameron Park's 20 miles of singletrack along the Brazos and Bosque. Nine to 11 miles, all levels, led by club volunteers. Helmets required. A Tuesday and Thursday 9 am version runs in summer.

name: Dam Ride (Tuesday Evenings)
schedule: Every Tuesday, roll out 5:45 pm (season starts in March)
description: The club's weeknight road ride from Waco Dam. Four groups: A is a drop ride at 20-plus, B and C regroup, D is no-drop at 13 to 15 mph over 25 miles. Helmets required on every WBC ride.

name: Orem Bicycle Coalition Monthly Ride
schedule: Second Wednesday of the month, 5:30 pm
description: A monthly community ride from the Mad Dog Cycles shop in Orem, run by the local bike advocacy group. Listed on the shop's local rides page; updates go out on the coalition's Facebook page.

name: SLCMTB Tuesday Weekly Social Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:45–6:30 pm; rotates between Round Valley, Lower UOP and Sparky trailheads

host.name: SLCMTB – Salt Lake City Mountain Biking

description: A weekly beginner-to-intermediate trail ride on Park City's flow trails. The group regroups at key intersections so nobody is left behind. Afterward, $5 beers and burgers at O'Shucks. The Meetup has about 2,700 members.

name: 999 Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, 9:00 pm (busiest in the warm months)

start_location.name: 9th and 9th
start_location.address: 900 S 900 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84105

founded_note: First ride was on a Thursday in 2011, per Utah Stories (Aug 2026)
description: Salt Lake's largest social ride: hundreds, sometimes over a thousand, meet at the corner of 900 South and 900 East every Thursday at 9. No gas engines, lights required. Leaderless and all-inclusive by design.

name: Bonneville Cycling Club Weekly Rides
schedule: Multiple rides most days of the week; see the club calendar
pace: rated O, B, C etc. per ride
description: Utah's largest cycling club, with 500-plus rides a year across the Salt Lake Valley. Each listing carries a pace rating, mileage and a Ride with GPS route. Weekday evening and daytime social rides are common. Check the calendar for start points.

name: Wasatch Mountain Club Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:00 pm; trailhead announced the Sunday or Monday before
founded_note: The club (not the ride) dates to 1920, per its Meetup page
cost: club membership required for the ride email list
description: A Tuesday evening trail ride from Utah's oldest outdoor club. Trailheads rotate around the Wasatch and are sent out on the club's bike email list a day or two ahead. Riders range from fast to new.

name: Tuesday Night Ride (NoVA Casual Bicycling Group)
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:30 pm
description: A B-group out-and-back on the trails from Shirlington toward Belle Haven. Nobody gets left behind but you are expected to hold around 15 mph. Helmets required, riders 18 and up. The same group runs a Wednesday beginner ride to the Dairy Godmother and a Thursday ride from Jones Point.

name: Tuesday Shop Ride (Blue Wheel Bicycles)
schedule: Tuesdays, gather 6:15 pm; location rotates between Biscuit Run, Heyward Forest and O-Hill
pace: two groups: Shred (fast) and Social (gentle, beginner-friendly)
description: A local mountain bike ride led by shop staff. Two groups: Shred goes fast, Social keeps it gentle and welcomes beginners. Meets at one of three trailheads each week; the shop posts the location on its website banner. Off the trails by dark. Riders under 14 need an adult.

name: Wednesday Mountain Bike Ride (Endeavor Cycles)
schedule: Wednesdays, meet 5:00 pm, roll 5:30 pm
description: A midweek trail ride from the shop, usually on the O-Hill trails across the street. All skill levels. If you don't have a bike, the shop says to ask. The shop also runs a party-pace First Friday cruiser ride, about 5 miles.

name: Women's Monday Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Mondays, 5:30 pm
description: A super casual no-drop trail ride for women on the Western Slope singletrack. Four to six miles of dirt and rock at a beginner pace with plenty of stops. Sign the Coalition's online waiver first; ride leaders can sort you out with a trail parking pass.

name: Slow & Steady Sundays
schedule: Sundays, 10:30 am
description: A casual party-pace ride from a small shop in Ghent. Eight to twelve miles at eight to twelve miles an hour. No drop, and the group waits if someone has a mechanical. Swing by early to see the shop. The Downtown Norfolk listing last showed dates through December 2025, so confirm with the shop before you go.

name: Thursday Community Road Ride (East Coast Bicycles)
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm
description: The shop's mid-pace road ride, 20 miles at 15 to 17 mph. Faster A and B groups go out Tuesdays at 6 and Saturdays at 7 am; Monday nights are a mixed-bag ride with changing themes. ID, helmet and lights required; no headphones.

name: Powhatan Courthouse No Drop (RABA)
schedule: Sundays, 9:00 am departure
description: A true no-drop club ride west of Richmond. About 31 miles on low-traffic roads with a store stop halfway. The leader's line: print the cue sheet or follow me, I will not let you out of my sight. Text or call the leader a day or two ahead to confirm.

name: RAR Richmond Monday Night Ride
schedule: Monday nights; time and start posted on Instagram
description: The Richmond chapter of Radical Adventure Riders runs a Monday night city and mountain bike ride. The group centers femme, trans, women and non-binary riders and prioritizes BIPOC and queer access. Beginner-friendly, with mechanical workshops and bike access regardless of income. Check Instagram for the week's start.

name: Saturday Bridge Ride (Blue Ridge Cyclery / BikeFitRVA Racing)
schedule: Saturdays, arrive 8:15 am, roll 8:30 am (Bridge Ride leaves 5–10 minutes after the A+ group)

start_location.name: Blue Ridge Cyclery Richmond
start_location.address: 5001 Libbie Mill East Blvd, Suite 100, Richmond, VA 23230

description: An intermediate road ride to Ashland and back for anyone who can hold about 16 mph on their own. It follows the same route as the shop's A+ race-pace ride, so you can start fast and drop back if you need to. Coffee stop at Classic Coffee, Tea and Books in Ashland. Helmet required.

name: Crank Sisters Social Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm
description: A casual ride for women, trans and non-binary riders. Ten flat miles on the Greenway and quiet neighborhood streets, with a detour to some rolling climbs if the group wants it. Snacks and drinks at the Cardinal Cafe after.

name: Tuesday Night Ride (Cardinal Bicycle Grandin)
schedule: Tuesdays, 5:45 pm
description: Roanoke Outside calls it America's friendliest group ride. Two options out of the Grandin shop: the Classic 4-Crossings route with climbing and a couple of regroups, or Flatlanders on the Greenway with no rider left behind. Text RIDE to 540-625-8806 for cancellation alerts.

name: Olde Salem Brewery Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 5:30 pm
description: A 21-mile loop around Salem with about 1,200 feet of climbing and a three-mile descent down the back of Harborwood. Splits into A and B groups. No drop. Ends at the brewery.

name: Sunday Beginner Ride (Tripower Cycling Club)
schedule: Sundays, 8:00 am
founded_note: Club site says it was formed in 1988
description: The club's newest ride, a 20-mile D-group loop for people getting into road riding. Leaves from Conte's on Laskin Road. The main Sunday ride goes 55 miles at 18 to 20 mph from the same spot at 7:30. Saturday loop rides split into A+ through C groups.

name: Vermont Bicycle Shop Pizza Ride
schedule: Monthly, April–October; dates posted on vermontbicycleclub.com
description: About thirty minutes of the easiest riding Barre has, then pizza. The shop's ride club also runs a weekly women-led beginner MTB hour at Millstone and a weekly training ride; updates go on the club site and Instagram.

name: GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride
schedule: Wednesday evenings; start time varies through the season and is sent to the club email list
pace: groups by average speed, 15 mph minimum
cost: free with a once-per-season waiver; membership optional
description: A 28-mile loop through Shelburne and Charlotte with about 1,150 feet of climbing. Groups of twelve or fewer form by speed; the fastest starts first. Faster groups may not wait. The last group regroups and tries not to leave anyone. You need to hold 15 mph to fit in.

name: Ranch Camp Ladies Rides
schedule: Roughly every other week, June–September; trailhead rotates (Cady Hill, Perry Hill, Little River, Adams Camp)

start_location.name: Rotating trailheads around Stowe; shop at 311 Mountain Rd

description: Free women's mountain bike rides led by Ranch Camp ambassadors, with LGBTQ+ riders explicitly welcome. Trailheads rotate around Stowe and occasionally Woodstock. Some rides are catered; order food by the Friday before. Sign up on Eventbrite.

name: Rabbit Ride
schedule: Every Sunday; 7:45 am in summer, 8:15 am in winter
pace: 16+ mph; groups leave by speed, fastest last
description: A self-organized Sunday road ride down Chuckanut Drive and back by Lake Samish. Groups roll out by pace, slowest first, fastest five minutes later. The shop is just the meeting spot and does not run it. Show up ready to ride at the start time.

name: Shifting Gears Women's Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Mondays, 5:30–7:30 pm, May through September

start_location.name: Galbraith Mountain or Lake Padden trailheads (varies weekly)

description: A weekly Monday evening trail ride for women 18 and up, whatever their experience, body size or nerves. Groups are capped at eight riders with two leaders. Rides go on Galbraith Mountain or at Lake Padden. Register ahead; sign-ups open two weeks before each ride.

name: Gravel Happy Hour
schedule: Second and fourth Sundays, October through March; meeting spot and time announced with each route
pace: two groups: a beginner ride and a faster ride

host.name: Cascadia Super Gravel with Big Stump Bikes and Olympia Mountain Bike Ride Club

description: Off-season gravel rides in Capitol Forest, two a month. One is a beginner ride led by the Olympia Mountain Bike Ride Club. The other is faster and led by Big Stump Bikes. Routes and meeting spots are posted before each ride.

name: Good Weather Sunday Social
schedule: Every Sunday, 10:30 am to about 2:00 pm
description: An all-inclusive casual ride from Tailwind Cafe on Capitol Hill with rotating leaders and a new route each week. Park sits and pastry stops are part of the plan. Rain or shine; ice or snow cancels.

name: Moxie Monday
schedule: First Monday of the month, 6:00 pm (has run weekly in past seasons; check Instagram)
description: A ride for women, trans, femme and non-binary riders on any kind of bike. Casual pace, frequent regroups and breaks, usually under 20 miles. Meets at Westlake Park. The same crew runs an annual W/T/F alley cat.

name: NorthStar Cycling Sunday Service
schedule: Sundays, meet 10:30 am, roll 11:00 am
description: A Sunday no-drop ride organized by and for Black, Brown and Indigenous riders in Seattle. Easy pace, rolls from the club's Central District clubhouse. The club's stated aim is to take down barriers to cycling and support riders' physical and mental health. All bikes welcome.

name: Seattle Bike Disco
schedule: Monthly, usually a Friday. Gather 7:00 pm, ride 7:30 pm. Next dates: Sep 18, Oct 23, Nov 20, 2026
description: A rolling dance party that stops to dance in different parts of Seattle, rain or shine. Costumes and bike lights encouraged, not required. All bikes, genders and riders. Route posts the week of. Has a code of conduct.

name: WTFNB Weekly with Brevay
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:30 am
description: A weekly morning ride open to women, trans, femme and non-binary riders, regardless of presentation. Rolling road loop of 15-plus miles at a moderate pace with frequent regroups. Listed on the Everyday Rides calendar with 34 past editions.

name: Bicycle Butler Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:15 pm
pace: social; regroups at turns and hills
description: A weekly shop ride led by Bicycle Butler's mechanics and friends. New riders welcome, all bike types including e-bikes. The route changes weekly and gets posted by noon on Wednesday. Runs year-round; lights required in fall and early spring. Helmets required.

name: Tacoma Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:30 pm, from a different local bar each week
description: A social Tuesday night ride around Tacoma. It leaves from a different bar each week, so check Instagram or Facebook for the start. Usually ends with a hangout after.

name: Wenatchee Valley Velo Saturday Ride
schedule: Saturdays, mornings (around 9:00 am in September; check the club calendar)
founded_note: Club started in 1998, per its website
cost: free for members; membership $40 single / $50 family
description: The Wenatchee Valley Velo club's weekly Saturday road ride, usually rolling from Wenatchee Valley Brewing Company. Rides are rated A, B or C by pace and by terrain. Exact times and routes are posted on the club's events calendar. The club also puts on some weeknight rides in season.

name: Wheel & Sprocket Appleton Thursday Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:00 pm, May 7–Aug 27
description: A summer shop ride around Appleton and the surrounding towns. Splits into two groups so slower riders have a place. Meets in the back lot of the store.

name: Market to Music Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:30 pm, mid-June through mid-August
description: A summer Wednesday meander from the Broadway farmers market to the City Band concert at St. James Park. All ages, any bike. Weather permitting. You can also park at the park and ride the route in reverse to shop the market first.

name: Smith's Women's Road Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 5:30 pm, May through summer
description: A women's road ride from Smith's downtown. Moderate-to-brisk pace, about 16 mph average. Moves to Zwift in winter. Email the shop to get on the list. Smith's also runs a Friday 5:30 pm all-levels mountain bike ride in summer.

name: Mad Town Mondays
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm
description: Madison's Monday party-pace ride. Usually an 18-mile loop out to the Lake Waubesa boardwalk, or a 12-mile Lake Monona loop when weather or daylight is short. About once a month in summer there is a longer 30–40 mile ride. Routes post to Instagram a few days ahead. Post-ride hangs most weeks. Bring lights.

name: Madison Queer Bike Ride
schedule: Second Wednesday of every month, year-round

start_location.name: Law Park, near the boat launch and tiny beach
start_location.address: Law Park, John Nolen Dr, Madison, WI 53703

description: A casual monthly ride for queer folks and friends, meant to be less competitive and less heteronormative than the usual group ride. Any bike that can handle pavement and path. There is a social stop each ride, indoors in winter. Runs all year except extreme cold or cold rain. Start time and route go up on Instagram.

name: Madison Women's Cycling Club Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm

start_location.name: Olbrich Park (Biergarten parking lot)
start_location.address: Olbrich Park, Atwood Ave, Madison, WI 53714

description: A relaxed lake loop for women, trans and non-binary riders. About 12 miles with a sweep so nobody rides alone. Most weeks there are two route options, posted on the club's Instagram before the ride.

name: Motorless Motion Taco Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 6:00 pm, roll ~6:15 pm, May–October
description: A short, casual shop ride of 6 to 8 miles, open to all skill levels. Everyone rolls back to the shop for happy hour at Bandit Tacos next door.

name: Capital Brewery Bike Club Tuesday and Thursday Rides
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 5:30 pm, late May–mid September (Wednesdays are e-bike night)
pace: A: 20–25 mph, 20–35 mi. B: 16–20 mph, 20–30 mi. C: 12–16 mph, 18–28 mi (e-bikes welcome)
founded_note: Club says it started in 2009 when impromptu rides turned into organized ones with routes and leaders, per capitalbikeclub.org
description: Three road groups roll out of the beer garden and finish back at it. The C group is for beginners and allows pedal-assist e-bikes. Wednesday is a separate e-bike ride and a CORP mountain bike group meets Tuesdays at 5:40. Cancelled if the beer garden closes or it rains after 5 pm.

name: Cadence Tuesday and Thursday Rides
schedule: Tuesdays from Bay View Wheel & Sprocket and Thursdays from Fox Point Wheel & Sprocket, 6:00 pm, May 1–Aug 30

start_location.name: Bay View Wheel & Sprocket (Tue) / Fox Point Wheel & Sprocket (Thu)

description: Two evening shop rides a week, about 20 miles each. The faster group drops; the second group holds 13–14 mph and waits for the slowest rider. Helmet, rear light, flat kit and a loaded route required. No e-bikes.

name: Broken Spoke Monday Night Road Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm
description: A brisk Monday road ride from the Suamico shop north of Green Bay. Averages 18–20 mph. The shop also runs Wednesday night dirt rides at 5:30 on rotating trails and a Sunday 8 am coffee ride at a recovery pace.

name: Tosa Full Moon Bicycle Ride
schedule: Every full moon evening
description: A slow 10-to-12-mile night ride around Wauwatosa on each full moon. Any bike. Start point and time are posted before each ride on the Milwaukee Bike Rides Instagram.

name: Mountain State Wheelers Saturday Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, April through October; 9:00 am spring and fall, 8:00 am June–September; start location rotates per the posted schedule
founded_note: Serving West Virginia cyclists since 1975, per the club site
description: The Charleston area road club's Saturday ride. Start point and route change each week on a published schedule, with Elkview, Winfield, Milton and Alum Creek regulars. Ride categories run from beginner to advanced.

name: MAMBA Weekly Group Ride
schedule: Usually Tuesdays, 6:30 pm, daylight dependent; trail varies
description: Board members host a weekly trail ride for members, friends and families. Beginner-to-intermediate level with regular regroups. The point is learning the trails and having a good time.

name: Bike to Work Wednesdays
schedule: Every Wednesday in summer, 7:30–9:00 am; location rotates weekly
description: Not a group ride in the usual sense: a weekly summer bike-commute meetup. Ride to a different bikeable spot in Jackson each Wednesday morning for free coffee and breakfast with other people on bikes, then carry on to work. Run by the town's pathways nonprofit.

name: Spinderellas
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:45 pm
description: A women's Tuesday evening mountain bike ride on the Happy Jack trails east of Laramie. Recreational pace, no-drop, fun first. Listed on Laramie BikeNet's group rides page.

name: Wednesday Night Pedal House Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 5:00 pm
description: Laramie's shop road ride, focused on paceline riding. It is a drop ride, but the group regroups and everyone rides back together. Pedal House has been in town since 1990.
